articleTitle: Advanced Synchrophasor-based Application for Potential Distributed Energy Resources Management: Key Technology, Challenge and Vision
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With an increasing number of distributed energy resources (DERs) integrating into the power system, the power grid is becoming more complex and uncertain. Owing to most of DERs are through grid-connected converters to integrate into the power system, the intermittent nature and resource-depended characteristic of the DERs are challenging their monitoring and control. Conventional synchronized measurement devices (SMDs) may be difficult to provide qualified data for DERs management for its accuracy and reporting-rate limitation. The monitoring systems developed basing on SMDs may be insufficient for depicting detailed dynamic manifestations of power systems with a high proportion integration of DERs. This paper shares some advanced synchrophasor-based applications developed in FNET/GridEye, which have a broad prospect for assisting system operator on the control and integration of the DERs.

articleTitle: An Online SOH Estimation Method Based on the Fusion of Improved ICA and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: State of health (SOH) estimation is one of the basic functions of a battery management system. Accordingly, the SOH estimation method becomes particularly important. This paper proposes a SOH estimation method based on the fusion of improved incremental capacity analysis (ICA) and long short term memory (LSTM) neural network. And the SOH is estimated based on data from the constant-current and constant-voltage charging stage. In order to make full use of the charging process, the entire charging SOC is spaced. The corresponding models are established in the different SOC intervals. The specific model is selected based on the data collected in real time, and the estimated SOH is obtained. Among all models, the maximum error does not exceed 4%.

articleTitle: Integrated Generation-Grid-Load Economic Dispatch Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In response to the wind curtailment problem with the increasing large-scale wind power integration, the integrated generation-grid-load economic dispatch method considering demand response is proposed in this paper. Through integration of the optimization of power grid structure and load side demand response into the traditional power generation economic dispatch model, the flexibility resources of generation-grid-load sides in power systems are mobilized to promote large-scale wind power integration consumption. The proposed integrated generation-grid-load economic dispatch mathematical model is transformed into a mixed integer programming model through introduction of the big M method. The analysis of practical examples indicates that the proposed integrated generation-grid-load economic dispatch considering demand response can reduce wind power curtailment and improve the economy of power system operation.

articleTitle: Control Strategies for Dc-bias Current Elimination in Dual-Active-Bridge DC-DC Converter: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The dual-active-bridge converter was attracted many focuses in the last few decades and has been adopted as the critical topology for the isolated DC-DC converter gradually. Because of many merits like galvanic isolation, a wide range of zero-voltage-switching, and high voltage conversion ratio, to name a few. The control strategies for the DAB are varies with a wide range aspect. Thus, this paper aims to review the control strategy in terms of the dc-bias current elimination in the transient-state of a single-phase DAB DC-DC converter. The phase-shift ratios patterns are introduced before relevant control strategies for dc-bias current elimination, which can be summarized as the piecewise linear optimization. Finally, the straightforward transient control which can be utilized in different phase-shift controls is analyzed as a universal solution.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Multi-energy Collaborative System Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In a multi-energy collaborative system, cooling, heating, electricity and other energy sources are coupled and complementary. Through multi-energy coordination and mutual assistance, their operating efficiency and economic benefits can be significantly improved. Demand response as a multi-energy supply-demand balance method can further improve system flexibility and economy, and power demand response as a viable method has been implemented in multiple provinces. In order to clarify the impact of power demand response on the optimal operation mode of multi-energy cooperative system, this paper proposes a multi-energy cooperative system optimized operation model that considers market-based elastic price-type demand response. First, the main components of the multi-energy collaborative system are analyzed. Based on the energy hub model, the multi-energy coupling characteristics are studied, and a price-based demand response model based on market elasticity is constructed. Based on this, the optimization with the lowest daily operating cost of the multi-energy collaborative system is established. Operation model; Finally, combined with actual case calculation analysis, it is verified that the adoption of price-type demand response measures can significantly improve the economy of multi-energy collaborative systems.

articleTitle: Prediction Modeling of Frequency Response Characteristic of Power System Based on Historical Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The disturbance brought by the connection of new energy to the grid poses greater challenges for the automatic generation control system of the power grid. In this paper, a real-time prediction method of frequency response characteristic coefficient of power system based on historical data is proposed, which can be used to improve the frequency deviation of the automatic generation control system coefficient setting. First, the maximal information coefficient is used as the index of the max-relevance and min-redundancy algorithm to extract the features of many factors affecting the frequency response characteristic in the power system. Then, according to the results of feature extraction, a prediction model for the frequency response characteristic of power system was established by using an artificial neural network with dropout. The analysis and comparison of different models using historical operation data of the power grid verified that the model has better prediction accuracy and generalization ability.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis of EV Charging Station Based on Measured Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As a non-linear random load, electric vehicle (EV) charging piles will cause a series of power quality problems in the distribution network. Therefore, it is of great practical significance to study the impact of harmonics generated during EV charging. First, based on the electrochemical theory of battery charging, the working principle of EV charging stations is described in detail. Then, the mechanism of harmonic generation in EV charging process, which is the theoretical basis for modeling the harmonic source of electric vehicle charging piles, is analyzed and introduced based on the existing charging methods. A simplified processing method of DC/DC power converter is proposed, and an equivalent nonlinear resistance model based on the state of charge of the battery is established. At last, the charging harmonics of EV are analyzed based on the measured data.

articleTitle: An Improved HVRT Control Strategy for DFIG
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper studies the high voltage ride through (HVRT) technology of the doubly fed induction generator (DFIG). Presently, traditional vector control strategies based on stator flux orientation (SFO) for rotor-side converter (RSC) always ignore the dynamic variation process of stator magnetizing current. This simplification will degrade the performance of DFIG during symmetrical voltage swells, which may even destroy the wind power systems. To mitigate this problem, an improved RSC control strategy considering flux linkage compensation is proposed to achieve high voltage ride through. The instantaneous stator flux linkage is used to replace the differential term of excitation current as feedforward compensation to reduce the influence of power grid voltage disturbance, which can have good transient and steady-state response during fault conditions. After that, the effectiveness of this method has been validated by MATLAB/SIMULINK. The results show that the improved RSC control strategy can not only provide enough reactive power for the recovery of grid voltage, but also effectively suppress the transient impact during the occurrence and elimination of faults. Thus, the HVRT capability of DFIG is improved.

articleTitle: Topology Review of Three-Port DC-DC Converters for Photovoltaic Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the increasingly serious environmental problems, the application of renewable energy, especially solar photovoltaic, has achieved unprecedented development. The application of three-port DC-DC converters (TPC) in a solar photovoltaic power system has becoming more and more extensive. It can realize the combination of unidirectional and bidirectional de power conversions in the circuit structure with the advantages of simple structure, low cost, and flexible control. In recent years, a number of three-port DC-DC converters have been reported, each of which has different features, such as different number of components, different efficiencies, and different power density. After comparison of those up-to-date different three-port DC-DC converters, this paper describes and compares how the three-port DC-DC converter achieves high voltage gain and conversion efficiency for a wide range. This review can provide guidance and reference for the selection of topology and future research hotspots.

articleTitle: A Unit Commitment Model Considering Peak Regulation of Units for Wind Power Integrated Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The high penetration level of wind power aggravates the peak regulation difficulty of power systems, and the traditional peak regulation approach may not be able to account for the rapid fluctuation of net load. In this paper, a new unit commitment model is proposed in which the regular peak regulation, deep peak regulation, and deep peak regulation with oil operation stages of units are considered. In order to effectively track the net load fluctuation, peak power regulation capacity and peak ramp regulation capability are scheduled to address the power capacity demand and ramp capability demand, respectively. The validity and effectiveness of the proposed model are illustrated by the case studies.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Combined Heat and Power Based Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The efficiency and economic performance of the microgrid (MG) are significantly improved by the combined heat and power (CHP) unit. In this paper, an optimal scheduling method for the CHP-based MG based on model predictive control (MPC) is proposed. Based on the energy hub (EH) model, the model of CHP-based MG was presented. An optimal scheduling model whose purpose is to minimize the total cost for CHP based microgrid was proposed in this paper then. And the MPC method was applied to the optimal scheduling model to deal with the uncertainty of renewable energy in the MG. The method is applied to a typical CHP based microgrid to verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Distributed Power Service Restoration Method of Distribution Network with Soft Open Point
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Soft open point (SOP) is applied to the power service restoration of the distribution network because of the advantages of flexible control mode and optimizing the operation of the distribution network. Taking advantage of parallel collaborative between independent peer smart terminals unit (STU) in distribution network and information interaction ways of working, distributed power service restoration method of distribution network considering soft open point is put forward, which brings the superiority of SOP in the aspect of power service restoration into full play and avoids the problem of large information collection and calculation in the centralized power service restoration method. Firstly, the structure, control mode and power service restoration model of SOP are introduced, and then the distributed power service restoration method of distribution network with SOP is described, which mainly includes distributed network topology search and the expression and calculation of constraint conditions. Finally, a numerical simulation is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved Extended Kalman Filter Based Dynamic Equivalent Method of DFIG Wind Farm Cluster
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a dynamic equivalent method for doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farm cluster utilizing an improved extended Kalman filters (EKF). First, the dynamic detailed model of DFIG is established. Then an online parameters identification method based on extended Kalman filter theory is put forward, Incorporating the equivalent wind turbine (WT) parameters that need to be identified into the state variables. Moreover, Levenberg-Marquardt optimization is used to adjust the prediction covariance matrix to ensure the global convergence of the algorithm. By iterating the reference point, the wind farm cluster with multiple DFIGs are equivalent to one unit. The frequency domain and time domain simulation results demonstrate that the equivalent method proposed in this paper shows a great ability to catch the dynamic responses of wind farm.

articleTitle: Faulted Line Detection Using Time-Frequency Information for Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The fault diagnosis technology of the distribution system is an important guarantee for the stable operation of the distribution network, and the fault line detection method is the premise of fault diagnosis. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of zero-sequence current when a single line-to-ground (SLG) fault occurs in the non-solidly earthed network, this paper proposes a fault line detection method that comprehensively uses the time-domain direction and spectral energy of the zero-sequence current, which can adapt to frequent changes in the operation mode of the distribution network. The effectiveness of the method is verified by a large number of simulation and field data.

articleTitle: Interharmonics Suppression Scheme in PV System with Variable Step Size MPPT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the Randomness and fluctuation of the photovoltaic (PV) system, Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm is employed to ensure the maximum power extraction from PV arrays, when it is connected to the grid. The previous studies have indicated that the MPPT algorithm is one of the main causes of interharmonics emission in PV systems. The MPPT algorithm parameters such as perturbation step size inevitably have a strong impact on the interharmonics in the current injected to the grid. In general, a smaller MPPT perturbation step size will reduce the interharmonics emission level, but it will result in poor tracking performance of the MPPT algorithm. Thus, there is a trade-off between the MPPT efficiency and the interharmonics emission in PV system. In this paper, an interharmonics suppression scheme with variable step size MPPT algorithm was proposed. In the suppression scheme, two voltage values near by the MPPT voltage and two tracking step size are preset. When the dc-link voltage of PV is between the two preset voltage values, it means that the PV power near its MPP and the smaller perturbation step size implemented in the MPPT algorithm. Otherwise, the bigger perturbation step size is employed. It can greatly reduce interharmonics emission level and maintain the MPPT efficiency. Simulations have been carried out to verify the effectiveness of the suppression scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis on DC Side Protection Strategy for Grounded Power Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of photovoltaic, wind power and other new energy generation in the grid and the rapid growth of electric vehicles, the uncertain of load in the power grid is increasing. In order to stabilize the load fluctuation and improve the ability of the frequency modulation and peak load regulation of the system, the power storage battery has been widely used in the power system. In this paper, the grounding type power battery energy storage system (PBESS) connected to the power system is taken as the research object. In order to improve its DC side protection performance and ensure the safety of the system. The fault conditions of pole to ground short circuit and the pole to pole short circuit in the DC side are studied. The voltage and current characteristics of the fault are analyzed, and the situation of the pole to ground fault in different positions of the DC side is simulated on PSCAD/EMTDC platform. According to the simulation results, the fault protection strategy of the DC side in the grounded PBESS is proposed. It can ensure that there is a main protection and a backup protection in case of any fault on the DC side, which improves the protection performance and better ensures the safe and stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: A Square Root Cubature Kalman Filter Based Dynamic State Estimation of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As PMUs are gradually deployed in distribution network systems, power system dynamic state estimation (PSDSE) has gradually become an important research topic in intelligent distribution networks. The CKF algorithm is improved, in order to solve the problem that the square root of the covariance matrix needs to be calculated multiple times during the iteration of the cubature Kalman filter (CKF) algorithm, which result in rounding errors. We introduce square root filtering (SRF) to improve numerical stability. A power system dynamic state estimation method based on square root cubature Kalman filtering (SRCKF) is proposed, and algorithm steps are given. Finally, a simulation is performed on the IEEE30 node system to compare the estimated performance of the three algorithms the unscented Kalman filter (UKF), the CKF and the SRCKF. It is proved that the dynamic state estimation effect of the distribution network based on the cubature Kalman filter is superior to the UKF method. At the same time, the SRCKF algorithm proposed in this paper is superior to the CKF and UKF algorithms in terms of filtering accuracy and numerical stability.

articleTitle: Prediction Method for Transformer State Based on GRU Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Dissolved gases content in power transformer oil can provide important information for transformer condition assessment. The recurrent neural network (RNN)has always performed well in the data labeled in the form of sequence but it has long term dependency and vanishing gradient problem. Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) is an improved version of RNN which deal with problems in RNN. This paper proposed a new forecasting model based on GRU network. The studies show that the model can effectively predict the change state of oil gas in power transformer. Compared with the Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) networks which is also improved recurrent neural network, the accuracy rate is comparable, and the training time is shorter and the universality is better. When the interval and fluctuation of data are greater, the prediction of the GRU network is also more stable.

articleTitle: Grid Voltage Control Method Based on Generator Reactive Power Regulation Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Too high or too low grid voltage will greatly affect the operation safety of the power system. This paper proposes a voltage regulation method based on generator reactive power regulation using reinforcement learning. First, the members of the agent are selected based on the reactive power of the generator, and then the Q tables are trained corresponding to the agent. According to the voltage amplitude state of the point to be adjusted, the regulation action is given. In order to solve the problem of complex combination of action sets and difficult convergence of Q table in a single agent, multi-agents are selected to decompose complex regulation actions into a series of continuous simple actions. At the same time, in order to improve the effectiveness of agent actions, the “progress” reward mechanism is proposed. The method based on reinforcement learning proposed in this paper can effectively regulate the reactive voltage of the system.

articleTitle: Study on the Aging Characteristics of Li-ion Battery Based on the Electro-Thermal and Aging Joint Simulation platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the wide application of the power battery system for EVs and energy storage battery system for the power grid, the analysis of batteries aging characteristics has become a hot spot. However, the aging of battery is a complex process, which needs to consider the combined effect of electrical and thermal processes. Therefore, this paper establishes an electrothermal and aging joint simulation platform considering the interaction of internal parameters of battery, heat transfer characteristics, and current feedback. The platform can simulate the closed-loop process of the internal thermal aging of the battery of the real working condition. Firstly, this paper introduces how to combine the electrical model, thermal model, and aging model of the battery to form the electro-thermal and aging joint simulation platform, and gives the process of battery parameters transfer and feedback. Then, through the simulation analysis, the curves and differences of battery capacity degradation under the single aging process and electro-thermal and aging process are compared. The results show that the joint simulation platform can get the process of cell temperature change and SOC change under the actual operating conditions, and the battery capacity declines faster under the electro-thermal and aging process, which verifies the effectiveness and accuracy of the joint simulation platform.

Author Keywords: electro-thermal and aging joint simulation platform

articleTitle: Integrated Planning of Transmission Network and Thermal Power Units’ Flexibility Reformation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Adequacy capacity and flexibility of transmission and generation equipment is the necessary factors to adapt to the gradual increase of the scale of loads and wind power. This paper proposes an integrated planning method of transmission network and thermal power units' flexibility reformation, and gives a joint planning mathematical model for the flexibility reformation of thermal power units and optimization of transmission network. The time sequence characteristics of load and wind power are taken into account in the proposed model to accurately describe the time sequence operation scenario of power system. The proposed mathematical model is transformed into a mixed-integer linear programming model and solved by mixed-integer linear programming algorithm. The example analysis shows that the proposed method can guarantee the expected wind power consumption, realize the precise investment for flexibility reformation of thermal power units and power grid development, and improve the economy of power system operation.

Author Keywords: Integrated planning, transmission planning, thermal power units’

articleTitle: Research on Causes of Transmission Line Fault Based on Decision Tree Classification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the needs of transmission line fault analysis and line inspection and maintenance, mainly considering the severe weather factors, in order to improve the analysis speed and inspection efficiency, this paper collected multi-source line data, established a line attribute information model, and proposed a decision tree-based algorithm for identifying the cause of line fault, the rules extracted from the historical abnormal data of the line establish a decision tree for line fault analysis. The analysis of test samples in the case proves the effectiveness of the algorithm model and the high accuracy of fault cause identification. It provides effective artificial intelligence diagnostic support for operation, maintenance, inspection and repair.

articleTitle: Research on Denosing of Vibration Signal of Circuit Breaker Based on Variational Mode Decomposition and Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The original vibration signal of circuit breaker contains a lot of noise, which seriously affects the extraction of signal characteristics and the judgment of the state of circuit breaker. Therefore, noise elimination is the premise of fault diagnosis of circuit breaker. In order to reduce the disturbance of noise to the circuit breaker vibration signal to the greatest extent, this paper proposes a denoising method based on variational mode decomposition (VMD) and wavelet transform. Firstly, wavelet transform is used to decompose and reconstruct the vibration signal of the circuit breaker. Then VMD decomposition was performed on the vibration signals after initial de-noising, and the effective intrinsic mode function (IMF) components were determined by the correlation coefficient criterion and reconstructed to obtain the final de-noising signal. By combining the advantages of wavelet transform and VMD, this algorithm is applied to the vibration case of circuit breaker, which can eliminate the noise and retain the useful information in the vibration signal to a great extent, and improve the precision of signal decomposition, and the result is better than the traditional signal denoising method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Control of Chaotic Oscillation in Power System Based on Relay Characteristic Function
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristics of chaotic oscillation of the second-order model of the power system, and presents an improved adaptive sliding mode control approach based on relay characteristic function. It restrains the high frequency chattering in sliding mode control. Lyapunov stability theory is used to prove the stability of the power system under control. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach could effectively control the chaotic oscillation of the system and suppress chattering.

articleTitle: Fast Equalization for Lithium Ion Battery Packs Based on Reconfigurable Battery Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a fast equalization method for lithium-ion battery packs based on reconfigurable battery structure and designs a new switching circuit topology. By adding PWM signals to the switching circuit, two internal structures of battery pack take turns to achieve the purpose of equalization. Without significantly increasing the number of switching devices, the complexity of the equalization strategy is greatly reduced. After equalization, the available capacity of the battery pack would be increased, the aging rate would be slowed down, and the service life would be prolonged. The detection circuit can ensure the safety performance of the battery pack and make the battery pack more intelligent. This proposed method is validated by the simulation results obtained from 16 battery cells in PSIM.

articleTitle: A Probabilistic Wind Power Forecasting Approach Based on Gaussian Process Regression
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Wind power forecasting (WPF) is an effective way to eliminate the negative impacts and enhance the market competitiveness of wind power. Probabilistic WPF gives the prediction intervals of possible output power, which may largely improve the confidence level and accuracy of the wind power forecasts. Considering the fluctuation characters of wind power, a combination scheme of different Gaussian kernels is used to establish the Gaussian Process Regression model, which is used to predict the mean value and the confidence interval of output power by taking wind speed and wind direction as input variates. Via the case analysis of a real wind farm in North China, results show that, the proposed Gaussian kernel scheme can well describe the fluctuation process of wind power, and the uncertain intervals produced by the established probabilistic WPF model basically able to cover the measured power. Compared with a typical statistical WPF model based on neural network, the improvement of monthly forecasting precision is up to 1.8 %.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic and Electromechanical Hybrid Simulation Based on Mosaik Framework
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents an electromagnetic and electromechanical hybrid simulation based on mosaik framework. The mosaik framework is an easy-to-deploy software package which is based on functional mock-up interface (FMI). Firstly, the method for acquiring samples of the network frequency response is presented, which is based on simplified models of power system components. Secondly, a revised vector fitting method is proposed to calculate the frequency dependent network equivalent (FDNE). Finally, the hybrid simulation is implemented by the mosaik framework, and the correctness of the method is verified by the New England 39 node system.

articleTitle: Comparison of Dynamic Behaviour between Average Model and Switch Function Based Model VSC-HVDC Converters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: One of the qualities of a good high voltage direct current (HVDC) system is robustness. The system should produce the output with very minimum harmonics distortion, and it should be stable against both small and large disturbances. In this paper, to determine the better model configuration of voltage source converter (VSC) that has both minimum harmonic distortion at the output and strong resistance to disturbances, the average model (AVM) and Switch Function based model were compared using dynamic behaviour validation. For analysis purposes, two point-to-point VSC-HVDC systems connecting two asynchronous high voltage alternate current (HVAC) systems which include two VSC terminals and the dc-link were developed base on the selected models. And two-level-VSC topology was used for simplifying calculations. The Vector control technique was proposed to control active and reactive power flow on the rectifier (sending end) and to control the dc voltage and reactive power flow at the inverter (receiving end). Using MATLAB SIMULINK the systems were simulated and the result was obtained and discussed. The results were good and accurate for both models but the only difference is that the high-frequency harmonics generated by the switching pulse cannot be presented by AVM since it can only present the fundamental component of ac currents and voltages.

Author Keywords: average model and switching function model

articleTitle: Faulty Phase and Faulty Line Selection Method Based on Three-Phase Transient Current
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The neutral point of distribution network is usually ungrounded or grounded through arc suppression coil in China. When a single-phase-to-ground fault occurs, the fault current is small, which brings difficulties to fault diagnosis. A method of faulty phase and faulty line selection for single-phase-to-ground fault based on three-phase transient current is proposed. Firstly, the faulty phase is identified by the difference in the transient current between the faulty phase and the healthy phase. Then, the transient current of each line is decomposed and reconstructed by the wavelet packet, and the ratio of the transient current energy in the selected frequency band of each line is calculated to identify the faulty line. Finally, several groups of artificial grounding experiments have been carried out in a 10kV real type test field to verify the correctness of the proposed faulty phase selection and faulty line selection method.

articleTitle: Planning and Design Case Analysis of integrated Energy Station for Urban Internet of Energy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Research on key technologies of integrated energy station is an important way to build urban internet of energy. The differences of electricity, natural gas, hot (cold) system offer great challenge to the construction of the urban internet of energy. How to make full use of the complementary characteristics of various energy sources and improve the absorption capacity of renewable energy is the key issue for the integrated and optimized operation control of urban internet of energy users. Based on an example of an industrial park in south China, this paper studies the typical application scenario of energy station, and studies it from the aspects of energy demand prediction and analysis, multi-energy complementary comprehensive energy station planning and configuration, investment and operation benefit, etc. The design method proposed in this paper has guiding significance for the planning and operation practice of integrated energy station.

articleTitle: Analysis of Hot Spot Temperature of Dry-Type Transformer Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The service life of dry-type transformers and their operating conditions depend largely on the insulation performance of its windings, the heat generation and heat dissipation inside the dry-type transformer and its insulation performance affect each other, together determining the overall working performance of the dry-type transformer. The internal temperature distribution of dry-type transformers, especially the hot spot temperature, has become an important indicator for its stable operation. Therefore, a more accurate research of the temperature field distribution in dry-type transformers is of great significance for transformer life assessment. Based on the analysis of dry-type transformer heat generation and cooling theory, this paper establishes a three-dimensional finite element simulation model of dry-type transformer, and conducts electromagnetic and thermal coupling simulation analysis of the finite element model to obtain the internal temperature field distribution. Compared with the actual situation, the simulation results are verified to be correct, the relationship between the hot spot temperature and the surface temperature is explored based on the existing simulation results and a mew method for calculating the hot spot temperature is proposed.

articleTitle: Topology Estimation of Power Distribution Grids Using Graphical Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Distribution networks represent the final tier in electric networks consisting of medium and low voltages lines that connect the distribution substations to the loads. Traditionally, distribution networks have been operated in a radial topology, with access to a lot of distributed renewable energy, the topology of distribution networks changes very frequently. Power distribution networks suffer from a lack of real-time observability, estimation of the topology is a critical problem for its observability and control. In this paper, a new method based on graphical is proposed, which uses the voltage measurements collected from the grid to estimate the topology of radical networks. The learning method is based on Euclidean distance and minimum spanning tree Kruskal algorithm. The performance of the method is verified by simulation of a distributed test case.

articleTitle: A Method of Frequency Features Prediction of Post-disturbance Power System Based on XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the frequency stability problem of modern power systems is prominent, rapidly and accurately predicting the frequency features of post-disturbance power system is of great significance for ensuring the stable operation of the power system. In order to achieve rapid prediction of frequency stability problems, this paper proposes a method for predicting frequency features based on XGBoost (Extreme Gradient Boosting) algorithm of post-disturbance power system. First, the maximum rate-of-change of frequency (RoCoF), frequency nadir $(f_{nadir})$, and quasi-steady state frequency $(f_{\mathrm{s}s})$ are used as output indicators to characterize the frequency features. Using the data before and after the disturbance to construct an initial feature set for frequency prediction. And through the Pearson correlation coefficient method for key feature screening. Then, an advanced machine learning method, the XGBoost algorithm, is introduced to establish nonlinear mapping relationships between input features and frequency feature indicators. Simulation analysis of the proposed method is performed in the New England 10-machine 39-bus system. The validity and superiority of the proposed method is verified by comparing it with two shallow machine learning algorithms, BP (Back Propagation) neural network and SVR (Support Vector Regression), and one deep learning algorithm, CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks).

articleTitle: Optimal Control Parameter Design for Dual-Loop Controlled Grid-Forming VSCs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Renewable energy/energy storage is generally integrated into microgrids with grid-forming voltage source converters (VSCs). The control parameter design of grid-forming VSCs is one of the most challenging techniques because of the inherent resonant phenomenon and the coupling issues between the current and voltage variables. This paper provides a simple approach to achieve the optimal parameter design of dual-loop control for grid-forming VSCs. The optimal parameter design is conducted for the current inner-loop and voltage outer-loop independently without any coupling. Moreover, in the proposed design, standard analysis and design tools, e.g., Pole-map and Bode-plot can be directly employed and complex formula solving is needless. Therefore, the proposed approach is easy to implement in practical. In addition, it has been identified that the proportional controller in the outer-loop has a negligible impact on the control bandwidth and thus can be removed to further simplify the design process and control structure. The left resonant controller can then be refined to achieve a significantly improved dynamic performance of the output voltage of VSCs. The effectiveness and performance of the design approach are carefully verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Single-Phase High Impedance Fault Identification of Neutral Ungrounded System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Most of 6-10kv distribution networks in China are neutral ungrounded systems. High impedance fault (HIF) is a common complex fault in distribution network. With the current is small and unstable, it is difficult to detect. In this paper, a method based on wavelet analysis and support vector machines(SVM) optimized by particle swarm optimization(PSO) is proposed to identify HIF in ungrounded systems. Firstly, a simulation model was established to simulate the high impedance fault. Then, discrete wavelet transform (DWT) was used as the feature extractor to decompose the HIF current signal by three-layer wavelet, and the signal energy of each frequency band was extracted as the characteristic quantity. After normalization, the feature vectors were input into PSO-SVM for training. Finally, the field high impedance fault signal is used to verify. Compared with the traditional method of SVM recognition after Fourier transform extraction, the recognition accuracy and speed are improved.

articleTitle: Integrated Operation Model for Shared Mobility-on-Demand System and Battery Swapping Station
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The shared mobility on demand electric vehicle system provides an alternative solution for sustainable, customer-orientated and economical transportation system. Meanwhile, battery swapping system could become a promising means for fast energy refill of shared mobility on demand fleet due to its unique operational characteristics. In this paper, a combined operation scheme for shared mobility-on-demand fleets and BSCS is formulated. The interaction between the mobility-on-demand system and the BSCS is modeled by the swapping demand. Specifically, swapping demand is determined in the real time scheduling problem for fleet operator and introduced as constants in the BSCS problem. The optimization problem is formulated as mixed-integer linear programming model and numerical case simulation experiments based on real-world data are provided. The case study results demonstrate the effectiveness of this proposed integrated operation model.

articleTitle: Research on the Composition and Allocation of Unbalanced Costs in Power Spot Market Under the Dual-track System of China
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Unbalanced cost is an important issue in the design of power spot market mechanism. China's power market reform has just begun and is still in a so-called “dual-track” system, in which the traditional administrative mode and the market mode both exist. This actual situation has made it difficult to deal with unbalanced costs in power spot market in China. To this end, this paper will focus on the problem of handling unbalanced costs under the dual-track system in China. Firstly, the problem of the dual-track system in China's power market are introduced and the differences of different types of power entities are analyzed. Compared with the mature power market, the unbalanced cost of power spot market in China is characterized by non-market unbalanced cost due to the existence of scheduled power electricity and the composition of blocking costs is also different from foreign power market. This paper analyzes the generation of unbalanced costs due to non-market factors in detail and puts forward some suggestions for its allocation mechanism based on actual conditions.

articleTitle: Impacts of Instantaneous Heavy Load on DC Distribution Network and Their Solution
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the gradual maturity of power electronics technology, DC distribution network has attracted wide attention. Instantaneous heavy load has an adverse effect on system performance. It will cause fluctuation of the system, resulting in poor power quality and system instability. Therefore, this paper is focused on the impacts of instantaneous heavy load on DC distribution network and their solution. Firstly, the impacts are analyzed theoretically. Then, the simulation is carried out and it confirms the analysis. Finally, the method of using energy storage devices and capacitors at photovoltaic is proposed. The method can provide energy for the system to support instantaneous heavy load, so it can improve the performance of DC distribution network during instantaneous heavy load, and meanwhile it is validated by PSCAD/EMTDC model simulation.

articleTitle: Simulation of Space Charge in XLPE under AC Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The dynamic behavior of the space charge in the crosslinked polyethylene insulation is one of the important reasons for the initiation of the aging of electrical branches in ac cables. In this paper, a bipolar charge model is established to numerically simulate the dynamic behavior of space charge in each AC cycle and the accumulation of space charge under long-term stress. Space charge under AC stress can be divided into two types: periodic charge and aperiodic charge. Space charge density and electric field are influenced by each other. It is found that the periodic charge at the electrode interface changes with the polarity and intensity of the electric field, and the accumulation rate is relatively slow. The aperiodic charge has a multi-period accumulation effect, which causes a certain degree of distortion of the electric field near the two electrodes. Compared with periodic charge, aperiodic charge has a more significant effect on cable insulation performance.

articleTitle: DC Impedance Modeling and Stability Analysis of VSC with Consideration of Grid Impedance
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper investigates the dc impedance modeling and stability analysis of voltage source converter (VSC) with consideration of grid impedance. Based on the developed impedance model, the parameter impact analysis is made and the influence of grid impedance and phase-locked loop (PLL) on dc impedance is revealed. In addition, this paper uses a resistance-inductance-capacitance (RLC) equivalent vector diagram to analyze the dc stability issue, and a virtual capacitor based active damping method is adopted to suppress the oscillation. Simulation results are given to validate the impedance model and stability analysis.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis of Grid-Connected Converter under Remote Voltage Sag with Reactive Power Compensation Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The renewable energy system and power grid are usually connected through a grid-connected converter (GCC), whose transient performance is significantly essential during the grid faults. In actual operation, reactive power compensation devices are often connected to the common coupling point (PCC) to improve voltage stability. However, there is a lack of analysis when considering the influence of reactive power compensation devices on GCC's transient stability. In this paper, the mathematical model of GCC when static var generator (SVG) is adopted for reactive power compensation is established. The AC-side equivalent circuit of the system, the state equation and the output power characteristic curve of GCC are obtained. On this basis, the equal-area criterion (EAC) for GCC is proposed to analyze its transient stability. Finally, the simulation of remote voltage sag under different short circuit ratio (SCR) is carried out to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Comparison of Harmonic Solutions to Power Quality improvement for Grid-Connected Solar Rooftop Applications in Industrial Plants
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The solar rooftop installation is currently grown in Thailand, when many solar inverters are connected to the grid. It impacts existing electrical systems such as the harmonic resonance occur and malfunction of sensitive equipment. In addition, electrical circuit breakers, contactors, fuses, and power capacitors are damaged, which can affect electrical quality in the system. The impact of solar rooftop installation on the reliability and security of existing power grids must be urgently analyzed. This paper examines and selects methods to reduce the harmonic effects caused by the increase in solar inverter installation in existing power systems. The main objective of the study is to reduce distortion and harmonic resonance problems in the system, as well as to select suitable methods for solving problems. Practically, it is ensured that the passive power filter system (PPFs), active power filter system (APFs) and hybrid power filter system (HPFs) are the best solution applied for grid-connected system. A method for selecting a suitable solution for solving problems in each plant was proposed. A comparison of the solutions to all three methods has been analyzed for maximum benefit. Guidelines, procedures, and operational requirements can be applied in industrial plants.

articleTitle: Safety and Damage Assessment Method of Transmission Line Tower in Goaf Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The transmission line tower is affected by the surface subsidence in the mined out area of coal mine, which will appear the phenomenon of subsidence, inclination and even tower collapse, threatening the operation safety of the transmission line tower in the mined out area. Therefore, a Safety and Damage Assessment Method of Transmission Line Tower in Goaf Based on Artificial Intelligence is proposed. Firstly, the geometric model of the coal seam in the goaf and the structural reliability model of the transmission line tower are constructed to evaluate the safety. Then, the random forest algorithm in artificial intelligence is used to evaluate the damage of the tower, so as to take protective measures in time. Finally, a finite element simulation model of tower foundation interaction is built, and its safety (force) and damage identification are experimentally analyzed. The results show that the proposed method can ensure high accuracy of damage assessment and reliable judgment of transmission line tower safety within the allowable error.

articleTitle: Refined Modeling and Real-Time Simulation of DFIG Based Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time co-simulation platform for wind farm based on RT-LAB and FAST, which can enhance the simulation accuracy of the wind farm. The complete mechanical and aerodynamic models of Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS) are built in FAST developed by National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), and the electrical part is constructed in the RT-LAB. In this way, the advantages of the two simulation tools can be fully utilized, and all dynamic behaviors of WECS can be covered. To guarantee its real-time characteristic, the FAST is running on the Xenomai-based realtime operating system, and it communicates with RT-LAB using User Datagram Protocol (UDP) which is widely applied in the real-time co-simulation. The correctness of the platform for wind farm has been verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Study on Different Modes of Reactive Power Compensation and Reactive Power Coordinated Control for Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: According to the grid codes, on wind farm for reactive power compensation and voltage stability requirements, this paper analyzes the extent of a static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) to voltage stability of doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) wind farm, compared to a static VAR compensator (SVC), and proposes a new scheme for coordinated control of reactive power between DFIG and STATCOM, to do this, DFIG stator, grid-side converter (GSC) and STATCOM supply reactive power to the grid coordinately, where the advantages and disadvantages of rotor-side converter (RSC) and GSC are taken into more consideration, and the reactive power control ability of DFIG is fully utilized. Based on test system, research results show that, STATCOM can provide more reactive power than SVC for voltage stability under the same capacity, especially during the serious voltage sag; The coordinated control scheme can not only improve the transient voltage stability, but also help reducing the capacity of STATCOM so that save the cost of investments in wind farms.

articleTitle: An Advanced Metering System Design Adapted to Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the rapid progress of China's electricity market reform, especially the development of the retail market, the current power information acquisition system cannot meet the requirements of the competitive retail market and demand response. Based on the development experience of metering systems in the UK and US electricity market, this paper proposes an adaptive power metering solution for the new demand of power metering system in the future market, which meets the needs of consumers from metering to application through the innovation of equipment and technology in four aspects: metering, acquisition unit, communication transmission and master station.

articleTitle: An Improved NLM Strategy for MMC Emergency Power Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved nearest level modulation (NLM) strategy for the modular multilevel converter (MMC) station to realize emergency power control. The sending-end MMC station whose ac side is connected to the islanded renewable power plant must control the ac voltage amplitude and frequency. The power flowing into the MMC station is uncontrolled. Power surplus situation (ac input power is greater than dc output power) will occur and dc voltage will rise to a damage value when the receiving end station blocks. This paper analyzes the working principle of MMC and introduces the traditional NLM strategy. Then proposes an improved NLM strategy. With the target of stabilizing dc voltage, the proposed strategy reduces the number of working MMC submodules according to the surplus power. The submodule capacitors absorb the surplus power by increasing their voltage within a proper range. The surplus energy is stored in MMC itself. The simulation results shows that this strategy can balance the input and output power of the MMC, and stabilize the dc/ac voltage. This strategy can buy time for the islanded renewable power plant decreasing output power without extra hardware addition. It’s convenient and effective to apply in MMC.

articleTitle: Study on Loss Allocation Method of Distribution Network with Considering of Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Based on the improved average losses allocation method, the losses of the distribution network, especially the harmonic losses caused by the introduction of distributed generation supply, is studied. Firstly, Considering the harmonics of the distribution network, the losses is divided into two parts, one is the fundamental wave loss and the other is the harmonic losses. Then, according to the improved average losses coefficient method, the fundamental wave losses is allocated to the load buses and the generator buses. Finally, according to the harmonic distortion rate of each buses, the harmonic losses is distributed to each load buses and generator buses. A small distribution network with multiple distributed generation is built as an example, the result verifies the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Power Prediction Method for PV system Based on Wavelet Decomposition and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: High penetration of Photovoltaic (PV) systems is variable resource as challenges to the stability and power quality of electrical grids. Accurate prediction of PV power has been recognized as a way to solve this problem. Due to PV power periodicity and non-stationary characteristics, traditional power prediction methods based on linear or time series models are no longer applicable. Methods based on neural networks are widely used for power prediction for PV system. Considering the training time and network accuracy, this paper discusses the factors in the prediction model. The number of nodes in the hidden layer that the network accuracy is high and the training time is guaranteed is determined, rather than just using the formula. After determining the number of nodes in the hidden layer, this paper presents a method combining artificial neural network (ANN) and wavelet decomposition (WD) for power prediction for PV system. Solar irradiance and other six parameters are chosen as the input of the hybrid model based on WD and ANN. The output of the neural network is reconstructed to obtain the final predicted power. The proposed model are validated by experimental data to predict the output power of PV system effectively and accurately, which is useful to enhance the safety and stability of the electrical grid.

articleTitle: Virtual Power Generation Optimization Model of Office Building in Virtual Power Plant Based on Comfort Loss
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to alleviate the unbalanced development of the power system on both sides of the source and load, the flexible adjustable loads such as air conditionings in office buildings and other industrial and commercial buildings are used to construct virtual power plant (VPP) for virtual power generation. When virtual power generation is used in office buildings with air conditioning load, the indoor comfort will change, which will directly affect people's work efficiency and dissatisfaction with environment. Based on this, this paper uses the evaluation model of interval number approximation to determine the level of comfort loss caused by virtual generation. By using the comfort loss level, the optimization model of virtual power generation for office building of VPP is established with the objective function of minimum power cost and maximum virtual power generation revenue. The feasibility of the model is verified by an example. The results show that on the premise of satisfying the overall average satisfaction and work efficiency for a day, timely adjustment of indoor comfort can not only reduce the cost of electricity, but also increase the virtual power generation benefit.

articleTitle: Smart Design of Distribution Series Capacitor Bank Application for Improved Voltage Quality and Motor Start
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The extensive radial distribution network to feed many consumers exposes to low voltage problem due to an increase in voltage drop. This paper introduces the series capacitor to improve the voltage quality to meet the requirement of the load. However, besides the advantages of the series capacitor, the sub-synchronous resonance problem should be considered when the motor start to operate. Therefore, this paper introduces a new design to overcome this dilemma instead of the conventional method (permanent damping resistor). Different methods have been used in and examined the resonance phenomenon during various load conditions to compare the results. Throughout the investigation mentioned above, simulation has been carried out with the help of Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP) and MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: A Novel Protection Method for Grounding Electrode Line of UHVDC Based on Injection Current
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In view of the Ultra High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) grounding electrode line protection based on injection method, this paper analyses the performance deficiency of the conventional protection scheme due to dead zone, and puts forward a new protection scheme of grounding electrode line. The new uses the head-end high frequency measured impedance transverse difference ratio to create the protection criterion, which only depends on the unilateral electrical quantity rather than on the communication channel. The proposed scheme greatly shortens the protection dead zone. In this paper, a simulation model was established using PSCAD/EMTDC based on the example of a certain ±800kV UHVDC system to validate the proposed protection scheme. Simulation results showed that the proposed protection of the new protection scheme proposed in this paper could greatly reduce the dead zone protection compared with the conventional protection scheme.

articleTitle: Misaka: Interactive Swarm Testbed for Smart Grid Distributed Algorithm Test and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, we present Misaka, a visualized swarm testbed for smart grid algorithm evaluation, also an extendable open-source open-hardware platform for developing tabletop tangible swarm interfaces. The platform consists of a collection of custom-designed 3 omni-directional wheels robots each 10 cm in diameter, high accuracy localization through a microdot pattern overlaid on top of the activity sheets, and a software framework for application development and control, while remaining affordable (per unit cost about 30 USD at the prototype stage). We illustrate the potential of tabletop swarm user interfaces through a set of smart grid algorithm application scenarios developed with Misaka.

articleTitle: Method for Finding the Best Charging Station in the Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the popularization of electric vehicles and the long charging time of them, it is easy to cause long queues in some charging stations. The waiting time of electric vehicles is too long, and the voltage load in different charging stations is also seriously unbalanced. This paper introduces a method of finding the optimal charging station based on the spanning tree algorithm in the Internet of Things environment, establishes the geographical topology model of the charging stations, and proposes a charging scheduling algorithm. On the basis of not changing the original construction of the charging station, considering from the users' side demand, the most time-saving charging station is recommended for the electric vehicles, which has the lowest charging cost. This method can also balance the load of each charging station effectively.

articleTitle: Traveling Wave Protection of High-Voltage Transmission Line based on Waveform Similarity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To further improve the reliability of fault judgment while ensuring the rapidity of traveling wave protection, a traveling wave protection method for high-voltage transmission lines based on waveform similarity judgment is proposed. The transmission process of the traveling wave after the line fault occurs is analyzed, and the similarity change law of the traveling wave on both sides of the line is studied when the fault is inside and outside the area. When a fault is inside the area, there is a big difference between the traveling wave waveforms on both sides of the line, and when a fault is outside the area, the traveling wave waveforms on both sides of the line have a high similarity. Hausdorff distance is used to describe the similarity of traveling wave waveforms, and then the line protection scheme of Hausdorff distance is obtained. In addition, to solve the problem that the arrival time of traveling waves on both sides of the line affects the Hausdorff distance calculation result, a waveform matching method is proposed, which can align the waveforms on both sides and eliminate the time difference of the waveforms. Using PSCAD to carry out simulation analysis of calculation examples, the results show that the protection scheme proposed in this paper has the advantages of high reliability, good quick action and strong resistance to transition resistance, which can further improve the reliability of traveling wave protection.

articleTitle: Minimum Frequency Predictive Model For Remote Isolated Power System Of Hydro Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Isolated grids in remote areas of southwest China are powered by hydro energy and faced with large load fluctuation. The low inertia and dominant water hammer effect deteriorate the frequency stability. Thus, a minimum frequency predictive model for power system containing hydro generation unit is proposed. First, based on the frequency response model of multi-machine system, two first-order transfer functions of numerator and denominator sharing the same order are adopted to simulate governor and turbine. The effect of zeros in transfer function, especially the water hammer effect, on the frequency response of power system is reflected. Then, the closed-loop of frequency response model is broken by approximating the feedback to governor using the exponential function. The amount of computation is thus reduced. The coefficients of the exponential function are obtained by implementing the balanced reduction method on the simplified closed-loop response of power system. Finally, the system of nonlinear equations is established through the open-loop transfer function. The frequency nadir of disturbed power system is obtained by solving the system of nonlinear equations using Newton method. The case study of an isolated grid in the southwest shows that the proposed method provides a quite accurate frequency nadir of disturbed power system containing hydro generation unit. The adoption of exponential fitting to approximate the feedback to governor improves the computation accuracy more than the linear fitting.

articleTitle: Unbalanced Voltage Compensation Strategy for Doubly Fed Induction Generator Based on Self-Synchronization Control without Phase-Locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper investigates the unbalanced voltage compensation strategy of the point of common coupling (PCC) for doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based on self-synchronization control without phase-locked-loop (PLL). The direct power control (DPC) scheme is implemented in a synchronous reference frame with the fixed angular frequency to avoid potential instability issues caused by PLL under nonideal grid voltage. The unbalanced voltage compensation strategy is proposed based on resonant compensator of PCC voltage. In order to balance the operation performance of DFIG and the power quality of PCC voltage, this paper uses a hybrid virtual impedance (HVI) method to achieve flexible compensation and avoid overmodulation, which needs both the feedforward of the PCC voltage and the feedback of the output current to develop the voltage references. Finally, the results of simulation validate the availability of the proposed compensation strategy.

articleTitle: Research on an MPC-Based Voltage Control Strategy for Renewable Energy Bases with Different Topologies
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the penetration rate of renewable energy such as wind energy and photovoltaic energy is increasing rapidly, the voltage control of renewable energy bases (REBs) attracts wide attention. As an extensively applied voltage control method in renewable energy power grid, model predictive control (MPC) has many advantages, such as good dynamic performance, ability to coordinate various reactive power compensation devices with different time constants, etc. This paper introduces an MPC-based voltage control strategy for a REB, in which wind farms (WFs) and photovoltaic stations (PVSs) are coordinated to keep the voltage of the point of connection (POC) within the feasible range. Because different collection topologies of REB might affect the performance of the voltage control strategy, three collection topologies including radial topology, chain topology and hybrid topology are selected to analyze the control performance of the voltage control strategy. A 400 MW REB with 2 WFs and 3 PVSs was used to analyze the voltage control effect of the MPC-based voltage control strategy.

articleTitle: Transient Frequency Security Preventive Control Optimization based on A3C
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Loss of massive generation caused by HVDC blocking or tripping of large power plants is a severe threat to frequency security. Only taking emergency control measures after the accident may lead to a large number of loads being cut off. Therefore, preventive control for transient frequency security is considered in this paper except the emergency control. In preventive control, new units are turned on to increase the system's spinning reserve. It's difficult to decide which units to turn on to reduce preventive control costs with regular optimization methods. In order to solve this problem, the reinforcement learning Asynchronous Advantage Actor-critic (A3C) method is applied in this paper. Firstly, Markov Chain is used to model the wind power time sequences. Then A3C is used to optimize the preventive control strategy at different time internals. A simplified provincial power system of China is adopted to verify the validity of the proposed optimization method.

articleTitle: Early Waming Method for Bearing Over-temperature Fault of Wind Turbine Based on Sparse Bayesian Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The bearing of the wind turbine is the carrier of energy transfer and plays a very important role in the process of converting wind energy into electrical energy.This paper takes the bearing over-temperature fault of wind turbine as the research object, and proposes a fault early warning model based on sparse Bayesian learning(SBL). Firstly, using the data collected by the SCADA(Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition)system, the relevant variables of bearing overtemperature fault are filtered and correlated to determine the input and output variables of the SBL model. After that, the SBL model is used to form the probability interval of the expected value distribution of the output variable; Finally, the result of the hypothesis test is used as a judgment index to judge whether the current operating state of the wind turbine is abnormal. Through the analysis of the actual wind turbine bearing over-temperature faults, it is proved that the bearing over-temperature fault early warning method based on the SBL model has strong practicability and can warn the bearing over-temperature faults accurately.

articleTitle: An Improved Control Strategy Study for “Strong HVDC and Weak AC“ Receiving-end Grid under Continuous Commutation Failure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The commission of QINGYU HVDC brings a large amount of clean power to Henan province, which increases the flexibility of the system operation and the complexity of the ACDC system operation. The strong HVDC and weak AC contradiction of the power grid is prominent, which is prone to commutation failure and threatens the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Aiming at continuous commutation failure of “strong HVDC and weak AC” receiving-end system, the paper analyzes the mechanism of commutation failure and the influence of control strategy on transient characteristics of multi-fed DC system, and proposes an improved VDCOL control strategy to effectively reduce the probability of continuous commutation failure and improve the recovery speed.

Author Keywords: The strong HVDC and weak AC

articleTitle: Communication Structure Design of Controllable Residential Loads
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A large number of controllable loads on the user side, especially scattered and flexible controllable residential loads, plays an important role in the safe, reliable and economic operation of the power grid. At present, they have been widely used in many aspects of the power grid such as demand-side management, dynamic security enhancement, etc. In order to achieve the integration of multiple controllable loads in the power grid, not only a reliable control strategy is required, but also need a communication structure with good performance including strong load-carrying capacity, low latency and appropriate network throughput. This communication structure would support the transmission of data packets or control commands between the controllable loads and the power grid. This paper proposes a three-tier communication structure of controllable residential loads, establishes a corresponding model based on OPNET and simulates in four different scenarios by collecting three statistics to verify the feasibility of this model.

articleTitle: Power Flow Calculation for DC Distribution Network Considering DC-DC Converter Control Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increase of the penetration rate of distributed generation, DC distribution network has gradually attracted attention due to higher power quality, lower losses, and larger distributed energy resource acceptance capability compared with AC distribution network. This paper proposes a new power flow calculation method for DC distribution network considering DC-DC converter control mode. Firstly, the steady-state models of voltage source converter (VSC) and DC-DC converter are established, and their control modes are analyzed in detail. Then power flow equations in DC distribution network considering different DC-DC converter control modes are derived, and the method for solving DC power flow problem is proposed. Finally, the modified IEEE 14-bus system is taken, and the program is implemented in MATLAB. Compared with the PSCAD simulation results, the effectiveness of the proposal is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Overvoltage Suppression Technology of Single-core Cable Shielding Layer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Traditional shielding layer protector of single-core cable can only suppress lightning and fault overvoltage, and can not solve the induced overvoltage and harmonic overvoltage caused by harmonics. When a discharge damping technology for shielding layer of single-core cable is proposed. Firstly, establish the coupling model of shielding layer by analyzing the mechanism of shielding layer induced voltage; then, study the induced overvoltage and resonance overvoltage caused by harmonics based on the model; furthermore, a technical scheme of reducing the overvoltage caused by harmonics by grounding the cable shielding layer through discharge capacitance and damping resistance in series is proposed; finally, give the method of choosing parameters of discharge capacitance and damping resistance. Theoretical results and simulated analysis confirm effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Mode and Operation Characteristics of DC Grid Connection of Distributed Generation in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Energy Internet is a hot spot of research and practice in the field of energy at home and abroad. DC power distribution technology has the characteristics of bidirectional controllable power flow, convenient access to distributed resources, improved power quality, transmission capacity and reliability of power supply, and reduced system loss, which has a wide application prospect in energy Internet. The safety and reliability of ubiquitous distributed generation (DG) and multi load access to DC distribution network is an important problem to be studied and solved in the planning and operation of energy Internet. In this paper, the different ways and operation characteristics of AC-DG and DC-DG connected to DC distribution network are analyzed, in which AC-DG is connected through voltage source inverter, and DC-DG is connected through full bridge DC / DC converter. Based on PSCAD / EMTDC, and taken Shenzhen flexible DC distribution network demonstration project as an example, the dynamic operation characteristics of DGs under different modes of connecting to the DC distribution network are analyzed and verified.

articleTitle: System Inertia Support from a Wind Farm Using Rotor Kinetic Energy-Based Varying Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Available rotor kinetic energies from doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs) in the upstream of a wind farm are different from DFIGs in the downstream due to the non-negligible wake effect. Thus, a variable gain of a droop control method is required for system inertia support because the constant-control gain method weakens the inertia support capability during disturbance. This paper presents an improved droop control method from a wind farm to efficiently utilize the rotating masses of DFIGs for system inertia support considering rotor kinetic energy-based variable-droop characteristics from temporal and spatial viewpoint. DFIGs in the upstream of a wind farm with large rotor speeds release more kinetic energy to the grid for system inertia support; DFIGs in the downstream with low rotor speeds release less kinetic energy to prevent rotor speed from stalling.
