Based on the frequency equivalent model, a PFR model considering thermal power investment and startup/shutdown is established, and the linearization constraints of PFR are derived theoretically. In order to minimize the expected cost of investment and typical scenario operation, a collaborative planning model of thermal power and renewable energy considering PFR constraints is built. Case studies based on the modified IEEE 39-bus system demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed method. Compared with ignoring PFR, this method can effectively reduce the cost of the whole planning and operation cycle, and improve the accommodation rate of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Control System to Prevent Collapse of Mixed-Source DC Microgrid for Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents the control of power sources by lookup table controller to maintain the voltage of critical load and to prevent the collapse of a mixed-source DC microgrid which consists of grid, diesel generators, batteries and solar cells that connect to DC bus. MATLAB is used to a simulation of the microgrid system. The experiment presents the time comparison of four types of switches including magnetic contactor, relay, solid-state relay and power MOSFET which can maintain DC bus voltage in a specified range which least effects to critical load operation. Finally, applied in the data center system of a small factory which has satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A Closed Loop Load Control Scheme for Stabilizing Frequency in Power System with Block Events
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The emergency frequency control of high-voltage direct-current (HVDC) receiving-end grid is investigated in this paper. While the multi HVDC feed-in system has several potential frequency stability problems, this paper mainly focuses on the worst scenario: frequency decreases on account of DC system blocking. A novel closed loop load control scheme based on the demand side control and wide-area measurement system (WAMS) is proposed. By deriving the power-to-voltage characteristics, the potential contribution to frequency management of industrial intensive load and static ZIP load is investigated at first. Then a multi-voltage level coordinate scheme is established with the help of wide-area measurement system (WAMS), which aims to maintain frequency stability when serious faults occur in the power system. The effectiveness and robustness of proposed scheme is validated through simulation on real-time digital simulator (RTDS) platform. An actual accident is taken as study case. Results indicate that the proposed scheme could provide remarkable improvement in both security and economic aspects.

articleTitle: A Fault Location Method for Local Control Distribution Network Based on Switch Status
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A distribution network fault location method based on the switch status information is proposed in this paper, which effectively solves the problem in locating the fault of distribution network under local control mode. Firstly, the design of system architecture is completed, and a line switch list is established according to the position and state information of the line switches, which is used to represent the topology structure and switch state information of the line. Then a switch action information processing method and an iterative search algorithm for finding out the fault section are proposed. In the following work, the algorithm is tested by single fault and double faults, and the results prove that the method proposed in this paper is practical and easier to implement, it can quickly and accurately output results for various operating conditions of the distribution network. And there is an advantage that the running time of the algorithm will not be multiplied with the increase of the number of fault sections, which has a good timeliness. All above proves that the method has a certain application prospect in the operation and maintenance of distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Intelligent Sensing Technology for Multi-energy Complementary Integrated Energy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the current multi-energy complementary integrated energy system, there are many problems, such as complex equipment operation, incomplete operation data monitoring, multi-time scale characteristics of the monitoring data and so on. In order to solve these problems, the research on distributed intelligent sensing technology is carried out in this paper. First of all, the multi-time scale data model and ultra-lightweight stream encryption scheme are used to optimize the existing measurement and control methods, and from three aspects of economy, technology, and environmental protection, a multi-index comprehensive evaluation system for system operation is constructed; secondly, using distributed intelligent sensing technology to collect and monitor the operation data of load sides and all kinds of energy systems including pOwer, gas, cold and heat, and has designed and constructed a multi-energy complementary integrated energy distributed measurement and control system; finally, the rationality and reliability of the stream encryption scheme and the multi index comprehensive evaluation method are verified through the application example analysis. This system have optimized data collection and transmission mode, realized multi-energy flow high reliability data collection and real-time communication, and imprOved the performance of the energy system.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Scheduling Strategy of Microgrid Considering Operation Interval Division of DGs and Batteries
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Real-time scheduling as an on-line optimization must produce dispatch results in real time, however, it is often contradictory between reducing calculation time and improving economy. In response to the real-time scheduling problem, a realtime scheduling strategy considering operation interval division of distributed generators (DGs) and batteries is proposed in this paper. The rolling scheduling models including day-ahead scheduling and hours-ahead scheduling are established, in which the hours-ahead scheduling takes future SOC deviations into account. In real-time scheduling, the output powers of DGs are divided into two intervals based on the ability to track the dayahead and hours-ahead schedule. The day-ahead and hoursahead scheduling ensures the economy and real-time scheduling keeps the calculation timeliness. Finally, a grid-connected microgrid example is studied, and the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy in economy and timeliness.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Control Algorithm for Suppressing the Resonance of Multiple Inverters in Parallel
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to suppress the resonance for LCL type multi-inverters parallel system, a new hybrid control algorithm for autonomous order reduction is proposed in this paper. Based on the hierarchical control structure of inverter, the two-degree-of-freedom control principle is combined with the current prediction model control. Thereinto, together with current model prediction control, the current inner loop of control layer can eliminate PI controller and PWM regulator and realize transfer function unitization of the current inner loop for order reduction. In the voltage outer loop of control layer, the principle of two degrees of freedom is adopted to construct the inverse model of the controlled object. And based on the current model predictive control of inner current loop, the unit transfer function of the control layer is realized. At this moment, only the application layer transmission function is left in the multi-inverter parallel system, the highest order difference between the numerator and the denominator of resonance transfer function is autonomously decreased. Finally, through drawing the bode diagram of the transmission function, the proposed algorithm is verified to suppress the resonance in multi-inverters parallel system. And its correctness and effectiveness are also verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation system.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Distributed MPC for Optimal Active Power Control of DFIG Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal active power control (OAPC) scheme based on hierarchical distributed model predictive control (HDMPC) for doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) wind farms. With the OAPC, the fatigue loads of WT are minimized in the wind farm controller while tracking the active power dispatch command. A hierarchical distributed optimization framework based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm is developed to solve the MPC problem, reducing the computational burdens of the central controller. In the higher-level MPC (HMPC), the computation task involves calculating a simple objective function with equality constraints. In the lower-level MPC (LMPC) controller (individual WT controller), the computation task involves solving a local small-scale constrained optimization problem. A wind farm model with 10 DFIG WTs was built to verify the proposed OAPC scheme.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Monte Carlo Algorithm on Substation Electric Inspection Robot Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Patrol inspection of power equipment is one of the key factors to ensure the reliability of power supply. At present, the conventional manual mode cannot meet the increasing demand of patrol inspection task, and the effect is not ideal. The application of electric inspection robot is the development direction of smart grid reform. Based on the analysis of real-time positioning and map creation of electric inspection robot, the patrol business feature model is established, and the improved model Carlo algorithm is applied to the slam of electric inspection robot. It is oriented to the working condition and the characteristics of inspection robot in the business environment, so as to achieve the effect of plane ground map creation and real-time positioning. The simulation results show that the slam of electric inspection robot based on the improved Monte Carlo algorithm improves the positioning accuracy and can adapt to the process noise in the operation of complex working conditions, which has a good practical application prospect and value.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Energy Storage Capacity Considering Wind Storage Joint Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For providing primary frequency regulation capability for high-permeability wind power grids, this paper considers the optimal allocation of the energy storage capacity considering wind storage joint frequency regulation. This article first proposes the coordinated distribution strategy of wind turbine and energy storage frequency adjustment power and the reserve method of fans in variable wind speed zones; then takes the energy storage configuration cost, operation&maintenance cost, electricity cost, wind abandonment cost and the frequency adjustment effect as the objective function; to meet the opportunity constraints of frequency adjustment power and the normal state of charge of energy storage, a joint optimization model of wind and storage was established; the genetic algorithm was used to solve the problem, and simulation was performed using Simulink. The simulation results show the model optimizes the cost of energy storage configuration, reduces the cost of wind turbine abandonment, and improves the overall economics of wind farm frequency regulation.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Parameter-free Fault Location Algorithm for Distribution Network Three-terminal Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Three-terminal transmission line is an important approach for the integration of distributed generation and the power supply of small loads in the distribution network. However, inaccurate or unknown line parameters can cause great errors in the results of most existing phasor-based fault location algorithms for this kind of line. Recently, one paper proposes a fault location algorithm without line parameter values, utilizing the post-fault measurements of three terminals. For the hypothetical fault on each section, because voltages at fault point respectively derived by three-terminal measurements should be equal, corresponding fault location equations involving the fault distance and line parameters as unknowns can be established. In addition, the redundancy of equations is enhanced using multiple groups of sampling data to reduce the influence of measurement error on the location result. Then, each equation set can be solved by the trust-region algorithm respectively. Finally, the fault point is located because the solution of equations is correct on condition that the actual fault point is on the assumed faulty section. In this paper, the above algorithm is evaluated under various fault position, fault resistances, fault types and usual measurement error, using Simulink and power system dynamic lab respectively.

articleTitle: Application Case of Transient Energy Method in Location of Single Phase to Ground Fault
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The distribution networks in China and many other countries are mostly neutral inefficiently grounding systems (NIGS), and more than 80% of the faults in the distribution networks are single phase to ground (SPG) faults. Due to the weak fault current and imperfect detection equipment configuration, the faulted line section location methods of the SPG fault in NIGS has not been effectively resolved. The development and application of μM-PMU provides more comprehensive fault information support for fault diagnosis of distribution network. When a SPG fault occurs, the transient energy of the faulted line section is greater than the sum of the transient energy of other line sections. A faulted line section location algorithm based on transient energy is proposed. The algorithm is implemented and embedded in the master station, and the corresponding interface is designed. A field test plan was designed and implemented in a 35kV distribution network. The test results show that the algorithm can locate the faulted line section efficiently.

articleTitle: A Novel Cold-Start Linear Power Flow Model Considering Voltage Amplitude
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Linear power flow is significant in power system studies, such as power system reliability analysis and real-time scheduling. Now, the DC power flow (DCPF) model is widely used, which could accurately estimate active power, but it fails to consider voltage amplitude and reactive power. To solve this problem, a novel linear power flow (NLPF) model considering voltage amplitude and reactive power is proposed in this paper. First, the classical AC power flow model (ACPF) is decoupled and linearized, and its accuracy is analyzed by comparison with other linearized methods. Then, according to the proposed model, the NLPF model is simplified, and the calculation process is given, and the calculation efficiency is analyzed at the same time. Finally, a general decoupled power flow model is proposed, and the accuracy and robustness of the proposed model are proved by several cases in Matpower6.0.

articleTitle: A Combined Modular Multilevel Converters Topology with DC Fault Ride-Through Capability for Bulk Power Bipolar-HVDC Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a novel bipolar combined modular multilevel converters (BC-MMCs) topology with DC fault ride through capability is proposed for bulk power HVDC transmission systems. The proposed BC-MMCs topology consists of two symmetric monopolar MMCs. Each of them is a combination of two types of converters: HBSM-MMC and the diagonal bridge sub-modules based MMC (DBSM-MMC). The two different MMCs are connected in series on their DC sides, and can be controlled independently. Replacing the HBSM-MMC, the proposed BC-MMCs is operated in current and reactive power control mode during normal conditions and is able to both clear the DC fault current and work in the static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) mode to provide reactive power to the AC grid under DC fault conditions. Compared with other MMC topologies with DC fault ride through capability, the proposed BC-MMCs is more economical for significantly decreasing the number of power devices. The operation states, control strategy and the DC fault ride-though capability of the proposed BC-MMCs are presented and simulation results using PSCAD/EMTDC validate the characteristics and advantages of the proposed BC-MMCs.

articleTitle: The Calculation Method of Optimal Thevenin Equivalent Parameters Based on the Fitting of Steady-State Response Characteristics of Nodes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Precise and fast parameter calculation is very important for online static voltage stability evaluation based on Thevenin equivalent parameter identification. The smaller the deviation between the steady state response characteristic between load node in power system and its Thevenin equivalent means the higher accuracy of the equivalent parameter identification. Based on the definition of node steady-state response, an identification method is proposed in this paper to calculate the optimal Thevenin equivalent parameters according to the minimum deviation of node steady-state response to improve the identification accuracy. Firstly, the objective function is established by minimizing the steady-state response deviation corresponding to the power flow calculation between the load node of power system and its equivalent circuit; then, the sample points on the node’s steady-state response characteristic curve are calculated based on the sensitivity of the node load perturbation. Based on the objective function and sample points, the optimal Thevenin equivalent parameters of the node ports are obtained. In order to improve the speed of parameter identification, the parameter calculation process is optimized according to the characteristics of the sample point generation process. Simulation examples verify the accuracy and speed of the proposed Thevenin equivalent parameter calculation method.

articleTitle: Operation Delay Prediction of Permanent Magnet Circuit Breaker Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: At present, permanent magnet circuit breakers are mostly used in the power grid to switch on and off parallel capacitors. Controlling the on-off of permanent magnet circuit breakers at a specific voltage phase can effectively reduce the inrush current and over-voltage that may be generated in the operation process. But the factors that affect the operation process of the permanent magnet circuit breaker are very complex, and it is difficult to use mathematical modeling method to calculate. In this paper, deep neural network is used to model and simulate the operation delay of PMCB, so as to improve the accuracy of compensation time and realize the smooth switching of shunt capacitor.

articleTitle: A Power Decoupling Method for Virtual Synchronous Machine in Low Voltage Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the distributed power source connected to the power grid with a high penetration rate, virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control technology has become a hotspot in inverter control strategy research. Power coupling is one of the problems faced by VSG systems, especially in the low-voltage power grid, the impedance of the line is resistive and inductive, which seriously affects the performance of VSG control. This paper mainly does the following work on VSG control: firstly, VSG control model is established by introducing the active-frequency loop and the reactive-voltage loop to achieve external characteristics. Then, compared with droop control, the influences of the moment of inertia and damping coefficient on the control performance are analyzed under the island and grid connection conditions, respectively. Finally, the power coupling mechanism is analyzed. Based on the existing control, the voltage feedforward link is introduced through the virtual impedance to realize the VSG power decoupling control, and it is verified by the more stable way of the VSG external characteristics. The above work is simulated on MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Thermal rating of Transmission Lines Based on Distributed Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Generally, centralized parameters and average temperature of conductor are used in calculating thermal rating of transmission line, the result of which may not be accurate enough for a long-distance line. This paper presents a new method to calculate ampacity base on the distributed parameter model. Firstly, given measures of the voltage and current phasors at both ends of the transmission line and the environmental parameters along the line, the weighted least squares (WLS) state estimation is set up to estimate the distributed resistances of line; And then, the distributed temperatures of line are obtained through the nonlinear relationship between resistance and temperature; Finally, the maximum temperature of those line segments temperatures is taken as the temperature of the line to calculate thermal rating of the whole line. Example results prove the method is efficacious and reasonable.

articleTitle: Modeling and Parameter Analysis for I/V Droop Based Control Strategy for Island Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive modeling and parameter analysis of I/V droop based control strategy for island microgrids, enabling each converter to output the synchronous currents to achieve a better power-sharing performance and avoid the frequency stability problem. This control strategy consists of one-order filter, I/V droop and current control loop. The state space model of AC microgrid consisting of the physical circuits and control system is established. Then, the effect of control parameters on the stability of the system is analyzed by calculating the eigenvalue locus of the closed-loop system. Further, the influence of control parameters on the transient voltage amplitude is analyzed by calculating the state space model. Simulation results using MATLAB/Simulink are presented to verify the validity of the analysis.

articleTitle: Logical Causal Model of Power System Fault Alarm and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper studies a logic causal model and an intelligent alarm analysis method for power system fault alarm. First of all, to describe the relationship of fault alarms, a logical cause and effect model is established, in addition, a knowledge base with the cause and effect set of both of the relay actions and the over- limited electrical quantity alarms is built; secondly, to process the fault alarms, an algorithm for the cause and effect relationship discovery of the alarm is proposed, the algorithm can merge large batch of alarms into a concise and brief alarm sequence demonstrating the fault developing process. The algorithm is tested with the 110 kV system fault case, the results show that the model can greatly compress the associated alarm signal and accurately obtain the alarm sequence, which can improve the work efficiency of the dispatcher.

articleTitle: Pitch Angle Control of Modern Variable Speed Variable Pitch Wind Turbine Based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of maximizing energy yield from the available wind is addressed by using a robust Proportional-Derivative (PD) controller in combination with a Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (LADRC) approach. Firstly, the theory of the Wind Turbine (WT) pitch control algorithms is analysed and then based on the analysis, 1.5 MW WT model with a Servo System (SS) and Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) is developed. The blade pitch angle (R) is controlled to ensure that the variable speed WT system operate safely and the optimum power is achieved. Developed LADRC algorithm reveal dynamic performance of the blade pitch angle, rotor speed and rated power characteristics. Within the wind turbine standard operating regimes, controllers have shown promising results. Proposed LADRC technique validates superior performance. Finally, MATLAB/SIMULINK tool box establishes the corresponding model to simulation test in order to verify the effectiveness and correctness of the analysed algorithms. Simulation result demonstrates that the developed pitch servo control system has good dynamic, steady state performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Flexibility of Integrated Heat and Electricity System with Multi-stage Robust Programming Considering Thermal Inertia of Buildings
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The ever-increasing penetration of variable wind energy requires a more flexible integrated heat and electricity system (IHES). In this paper, a multi-stage robust programming framework is proposed to leverage the thermal inertia of the IHES to absorb the variable wind energy. Firstly, the virtual heat storage model is established to characterize the thermal inertia of buildings inside the IHES. Then, the economic dispatch of IHES is formulated as a multi-stage robust programming problem, where the uncertainty of the wind power generation and the inter-temporal constraints of IHES are properly considered. An improved robust dual dynamic programming algorithm is developed to efficiently solve the proposed model. Finally, a case study is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model. Numerical results show that compared with the existing methods, the proposed model further reduces the wind curtailment levels while keeping the indoor temperature within the limit.

articleTitle: A Method for Multi-HVDC Grouping Based on Spectral Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To satisfy the increasing power demands in load center, multiple HVDCs have been integrated into the receiving grid in China. The reality raises the coordination issues of HVDCs. A HVDC grouping method for optimizing the management of multiple HVDCs is proposed in this paper. Several kinds of relationship in coordination and complementarity between HVDCs are analyzed and quantified. Based on graph theory, HVDC grouping is transformed into a graph-cut problem and solved by spectral clustering algorithm. The proposed method is implemented on a practical multi-HVDC grid, and the results show its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Management for Distribution Networks with Multi-stakerholder Power Sources and Loads
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Distribution networks can receive diversified energy and then deliver them to customers, which facilitates the development of multi-stakeholder power sources and loads. In order to ensure the stability of power system operation, optimal energy management for distribution networks is a significant and challenging problem considering power sources and loads belonging to separate entities. Many existing works focused on the economic benefits of distribution networks without consideration of the privacy and independent decisions of stakeholders. In this paper, a distributed hierarchical energy management method is proposed to minimize costs of all stakeholders simultaneously. A bi-level nonlinear programming model is proposed to characterize the energy production and trading processes between distribution networks and multi-stakeholder power sources and loads. Then, a Lagrangian relaxation based computing algorithm is applied to solve the proposed model in a distributed manner. Finally, the proposed energy management approach is verified in the actual operating case in Shandong power grid, China. It is proved to be an effective method for the energy management of distribution networks with multi-stakeholder power sources and loads.

articleTitle: Current Limiting Strategy of DC Distribution Network Based on Bridge Circuit
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid flexible current limiter is proposed to solve the problem of short circuit between positive pole and negative pole in DC distribution network. The current limiter consists of superconducting resistance and self-excited current limiter. In normal operating condition, the current limiter and self-excited current limiter are bypassed by the bridge circuit, so that the current limiter has no impact on DC distribution network. When a short-circuit fault happens between positive pole and negative pole, the bypass function of bridge circuit is failed. With the help of the current limiter, the fault current and the voltage drop of interelectrode capacitance can be quickly suppressed by superconducting resistance. For fully remove the negative effect of fault on interelectrode capacitance, through offering a controlled linearly rising current to an inductor in the set time, the self-excited current limiter can provide a positive clamping voltage, so as to keep the interelectrode capacitance’s voltage in its rated value. Finally, based on the theoretical derivation and simulation results, it can be proved that the major problems troubling a DC distribution network’s fault ride-through technologies can be resolved by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Classification of Self-Provided Power Plants and Their Interactive Potentials with Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In 2015, the new round of power system reform proposed to strengthen and standardize the supervision and administration of the self-provided power plants and clarified the direction of developing the self-provided power plants towards qualified market entities. Focusing on the issue of clearly defining the self-provided power plant, the paper proposes the classification methods based on power generation side and load side, and in line with theoretical study and practical investigation, analyzes the potentials of typical self-provided power plants for power grid, aiming to provide an important reference for engagement of more self-provided power plants in grid supply and demand. The study results show that featured with favorable regulating potential and policy impetus, the conventional coal-fired self-provided power plants will be the main force to participate in the interaction with grid supply and demand and consume clean energy in the future.

articleTitle: Short-term Voltage Stability Assessment of AC/DC Power Grid based on SDAE and ADAM Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of HVDC transmission and changes of load composition and characteristics, the short-term voltage problem seriously threatens the safety and stable operation of power systems. A short-term voltage stability assessment method based on deep learning neural network for AC/DC receiving-end power grid is proposed in this paper. The stacked denoising autoencoder (SDAE) and adaptive moment estimation (ADAM) algorithms are used to build a rapid evaluation model, and the training sample set is used to train the transient voltage stability rapid evaluation model. The steady-state power flow features are used as inputs and an index of quantifying short-term voltage stability of commutation bus is utilized as the output. Simulation results of real multi-infeed AC/DC power grid demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis on DC Side Protection Strategy for Ungrounded Power Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the rapid increase of new energy penetration, the randomness and volatility of power grid are facing more challenges. Therefore, power battery energy storage system (PBESS) has been widely used in power system. But at present, the development of safety protection technology of PBESS is relatively lagging behind, so this paper analyzes and calculates the DC side fault characteristics of ungrounded PBESS, and uses PSCAD / EMTDC platform to simulate the situation when there is fault at different positions of the DC side. According to the simulation results, the DC side fault protection strategy of non grounded PBESS system is proposed.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis of Weather Factors Affecting PV Module Output Power Based on Artificial Neural Network and Sobol Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: There are many factors in weather conditions affecting the output power of photovoltaic (PV) modules in the PV system. For better modelling the output of PV modules, it is necessary to analyze the input factors of the model, finding out the key factors or combinations that affect the output greatly. In this paper, sensitivity analysis was accomplished to analyze the input weather factors of PV modules precisely by combing Sobol algorithm and artificial neural network (ANN). First, the modeling of output power of PV modules was realized by ANN self-learning method with the help of experimental data. Then, a sensitivity analysis with Sobol algorithm was built to study the sensitivity of the change of output power for PV modules with the change of three input weather factors, including solar irradiance, module temperature, and air relative humidity, and obtain sensitivity coefficients of these weather factors. Finally, the welltrained ANN model with high fitting accuracy was utilized for Sobol sensitivity analysis, giving a reliable analyzing result of the weather factors.

articleTitle: Endurance optimization of Unmanned Underwater Vehicle Based on Three-level optimization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to obtain better endurance performance of unmanned underwater vehicle under limited resources, the paper proposes a three-level optimization strategy for the fuel cell hybrid system. The first level optimization takes the minimum total instantaneous hydrogen consumption of fuel cell system as optimization objective. It optimizes the power distribution between two fuel cell subsystems. The second level optimization optimizes the speed of unmanned underwater vehicle with the maximum endurance in the later stage of submarine. The later stage is the time after either fuel cell system or battery system resource of the hybrid system is exhausted. The third level optimization optimizes the power distribution between fuel cell system and battery system and the speed of unmanned underwater vehicle in the early stage of submarine. During the early stage of submarine, fuel cell system and battery system supply power for propulsion together. Simulation results show the optimization model proposed in the paper is reasonable and it can effectively improve the endurance performance of unmanned underwater vehicle and reduce the total instantaneous hydrogen consumption of fuel cell system.

articleTitle: Impact of Industrial Virtual Power Plant on Renewable Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Industrial park is one of the typical energy consumption patterns in power system due to heavy industrial loads and their ability to respond to electricity prices. Therefore, the energy integration in the industrial sector is significant. The concept of industrial virtual power plant (IVPP) has been proposed to deal with such problems. This paper demonstrates an IVPP model to managing resources in an eco-industrial park, including energy storage systems, demand response (DR) resources and distributed energy resources such as wind and solar. By maximizing the daily benefits of IVPP owners in day-ahead market, DR and batteries are scheduled economically, and the energy between the grid and IVPP can flow in both directions. The case studies under three wind-level scenarios demonstrate the efficient synergies between IVPP resources. The validation results indicate that IVPP could optimize supply side and demand side resources in industrial parks and help decarbonization of power systems.

articleTitle: A Voltage Sag Immunity Testing Method for Industrial Process Based on Electrical-Physical Properties
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Voltage sag often leads to interruption of industrial production processes, which brings huge economic losses to users. Taking measures from the user side is the main measure to mitigate the effects of voltage sag today. Reasonable evaluation of voltage sag immunity in industrial process is the premise of the degradation of governance. However, the current evaluation method needs to test the entire industrial process, which will cause economic losses to the users who conduct the test. Therefore, this test scheme has no practical evaluation value. This article is based on the relationship between equipment attributes and process physical attributes. Further link the equipment endurance ability with the industrial process endurance ability, through the test of single equipment to achieve the assessment of the entire industrial process endurance ability. At the same time, the case study of an industrial park shows the practicability and effectiveness of the scheme.

articleTitle: A Flexible Multi-objective Coordinated Control Strategy for Smart Loads Based on Electric Springs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: High penetration of new energy distributed generation brings new challenges to the power quality, therefore, the concept of electric springs (ESs) is proposed recently and arises great concern. Current research of ESs mainly focuses on the function of maintaining the stability of the AC bus voltage under the steady-state conditions, but rarely involves the frequency regulation and rapid voltage recovery during the transient period. In order to achieve these objectives, this paper proposes a flexible multi-objective coordinated control strategy for smart loads based on the ESs. The output frequency of the phase-locked loop (PLL) is controlled to track the reference value, thus the system frequency can be significantly improved during the fault. For rapid voltage recovery during the fault, the control mode switches between the reactive-power-targeting (RPT) mode and voltage-targeting (VT) mode adaptively based on the fuzzy logic, according to the working conditions of the system. The instantaneous demand for reactive power can be calculated based on the instantaneous reactive power theory (IRPT), so the RPT mode can have the effect of flexible reactive power tracking and improving the speed of voltage recovery. The simulation results of a micro-grid system based on Simulink verify the feasibility of the proposed flexible multi-objective coordinated control strategy.

articleTitle: Electro-Thermodynamics Modeling of Aluminum Smelter Load Based on Direct Load Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The aluminum smelter load is a kind of high-quality thermal storage characteristic load, which will not affect the production quality of electrolytic aluminum if the power is cut off for a short time or the operation parameters are adjusted. In addition, the individual load of aluminum smelter load is large, which is convenient for centralized control. Therefore, it is of great significance to bring the aluminum smelter load into the direct load control. In this paper, the basic working principle of aluminum smelter load is analyzed. On this basis, the electrothermal characteristic model of aluminum smelter load is put forward, which can quantitatively describe the relationship between input power and electrolyte temperature, and provide load control constraints for the direct control of electrolytic aluminum. The feasibility of aluminum smelter load participating in direct load control is verified by simulation example.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Storage System Planning Method of DC Distribution Network Based on Energy Storage Battery and Super Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Energy Internet is a hot spot of research and practice in the field of energy at home and abroad. DC power distribution technology is an important element of energy Internet. How to plan the type and capacity of energy storage system (ESS) is a problem worthy of attention when designing the optimal energy conversion path in the energy Internet, especially in the DC distribution network. The proper type and capacity of ESS can effectively suppress DC voltage flicker and improve the system operation stability and fault crossing ability. In this paper, the hybrid energy storage scheme of energy storage battery and super capacitor is adopted in DC distribution network, and the discrete Fourier spectrum analysis of power demand sample data is carried out to obtain the basic power in low frequency and fluctuating power in high frequency. The energy storage battery with slow dynamic response speed is used to match the power demand of low-frequency segment, and the super capacitor with slow dynamic response speed is used to match the power demand of high-frequency segment. The influence index of SOC over limit times of energy storage system is introduced to seek the critical value of ESS capacity planning. Finally, the proposed hybrid energy storage planning method is verified by the case studying.

articleTitle: Controlled Splitting Surface Searching Strategy Based on Intelligent Algorithm under Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Controlled splitting is an important measure to ensure the safety of the Energy Internet. An improved ant colony optimization algorithm is proposed in order to reduce the high complexity of the solution process in this paper. Firstly, establish a mathematic model for controlled splitting surface searching and map it to ant colony optimization algorithm with a single objective function and multiple constraints. Then, based on the connectivity constraint, the optimal controlled islanding solution can be obtained. Simulation results of IEEE 118-bus system verify the effectiveness and rapidity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Measurement and Control Devices in Distribution Network Based on Life Cycle Cost
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Reasonably configuring the measurement and control devices represented by the distribution terminal and micro-phasor measurement unit (μPMU) can improve the power supply reliability of the distribution network. Considering the devices costs and outage losses within the life cycle of devices, this paper proposes an optimal configuration model for measurement and control devices. Taking the average annual power outage time of users as the index of power supply reliability, the impact of the measurement and control devices on the power supply reliability is analyzed. Then take the lowest economic cost of distribution network in the life cycle of devices as the objective, and the genetic algorithm is used to solve the optimal configuration model. Finally, the proposed model is applied to an IEEE RBTS BUS-2 test system. The results show that the proposed model can achieve the best economic efficiency on the basis of ensuring the power supply reliability, and the effectiveness of the model is verified.

articleTitle: A Phasor Measurement Method Considering Decaying DC Component
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a phasor measurement method that can eliminate the interference of the decaying DC component. Aiming at the problem that the phasor measurement accuracy is affected by the decaying DC component in the case of faults, a signal model considering complex conditions is constructed. This model considers the interference of multiple factors such as multiple decaying DC components, frequency deviation, harmonics, and noise. In this paper, the proposed signal model is fitted by a fitting method to avoid the interference of frequency deviation and noise. Then, the frequencies of each signal component obtained by the spatial spectrum estimation method are used as the known parameters of the model. Finally, the amplitude and phase of the fundamental phasor are solved by the least square method. The interference of the decaying DC component on the phasor measurement in a complex environment is effectively suppressed by the proposed method, and the accuracy of the phasor measurement in the case of faults is improved.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique to Identify Proper Locations for Distributed Renewable Generation Integration to Minimize Contingency Impact
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a novel technique to define proper locations for distributed renewable generation (DRG) integration to minimize contingency impact. The contingency (n1) analysis and the repeated power flow technique are used to investigate the Critical Voltage Buses (CVB). Then priority rankings are defined in two considerations, the number of impacts and voltage level at the CVB. The POWERWORLD simulator is used in this study to analyze the modified Thailand power system during peak load period. The results show that the proposed technique can identify the priority CVBs, which are the proper locations for DRG installation. With more DRG installations at the CVBs, the numbers of CVB, generator capacity and power system loss can be decreased and the load demand can be increased. This proposed novel technique can be applied effectively for the power system security enhancement.

articleTitle: A Novel Non-unit Frequency-Based Line Protection Scheme for Flexible DC Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To address the problems still existing in line protection for flexible DC grids currently, this paper proposes a non-unit frequency-based line protection scheme for flexible DC grids. Firstly, the values of the initial voltage traveling waves (IVTWs) generated by the fault point under internal and external faults are respectively calculated based on the equivalent model of the four-terminal flexible DC grid. Due to the boundary effect of the current limiting inductors on both ends of DC lines, the attenuation rates of the IVTWs with the increase of frequency under internal and external faults have different characteristics. The detail coefficients of the IVTW in different frequency bands are extracted by stationary wavelet transform at different scales, and the amplitudes of the IVTW in different frequency bands are expressed by wavelet transform modulus maximums (WTMMs). A criterion to identify internal and external faults is constructed based on the square of the frequency-domain equivalent attenuation rate of the IVTW. Lastly, simulation results under diverse fault conditions validate the availability of the proposed protection method.

articleTitle: Frequency Characteristics Concerned Transmission Planning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the gradual increase of power grid scale and the gradual complexity of power sources and electric loads, the frequency characteristics of power system are becoming more and more complex. The frequency characteristics are closely related to the electric power grid structure and electrical distances between power sources and electric loads. This paper proposed a transmission planning method concerning power system frequency characteristics. Firstly, mechanism analysis of the space-time distribution of power system frequency is conducted, and the measurement indicators of power system frequency space-time distribution are given. Then the transmission planning method considering frequency space-time distribution characteristics is formulated based on the given measurement indicators. Finally, case studies on a provincial power grid of China are conducted, and the numerical analysis illustrated the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Robust Unit Commitment Model of Electricity-Natural Gas System Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The integrated power and natural gas system (IEGS) provides a new way to increase wind power consumption. This paper proposes a data-driven robust unit commitment (UC) of IEGS considering wind power uncertainty. Firstly, wind power forecast errors are clustered via infinite Gaussian mixture model (IGMM), and a data-driven uncertainty set is derived afterward. Then a two-stage IEGS unit commitment model is established, in which dynamic natural gas flow is considered. Based on the second-order cone (SOC) method, the nonconvex constraints of the dynamic natural gas flow are transformed into convex ones. In order to solve this min-max-max-min UC optimization problem, a Column Constraint Generation (C&CG) based algorithm is further developed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated with 6-bus-6-node IEGS and 118-bus-10-node IEGS.

Author Keywords: integrated power and natural gas system

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Technical Loss Influence Factors Based on Multi-scenario Generation Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Technical losses (TL) consist of the power dissipation in each component of the power system. This paper proposes a quantitative method to analyze TL influence factors based on multi-scenario generation technology. The index system of TL influence factors is first established. Then, based on generative adversarial networks (GANs) and K-means, the typical scenarios for TL influence factor analysis are generated. The entropy weight is integrated with the grey correlation analysis algorithm to determine the critical influence factors. The results show that the proposed method effectively analyzes TL influence factors.

articleTitle: On-line Monitoring of Filter Inductance Suitable for Voltage Sensor-less Direct Power Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes an on-line filter inductance estimation method suitable for grid connected inverters under AC-side voltage sensor-less control. The proposed system adopts direct power prediction control for fundamental control to the output power of the power electronics. The voltage at point of common coupling(PCC), which is required for determining thus guiding the current output and power factor, is obtained using virtual flux estimation instead of AC side voltage sensors. The proposed on-line detection method of filter inductors employed the idea of predictive control. The rolling optimization, mathematical modelling and cost function is built for minimizing the error between the estimated and actual inductance of the filter. This would reduce the negative effect of inaccurate inductance value in the voltage sensor-less control. The proposed method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Power Differential Protection Scheme for Distribution Network with High Penetration of Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Distribution network changes from single-source network to multi-source network with bi-directional power flow due to connection with a large quantity of distributed generation (DG). Traditional three-stage over-current protection for the network may maloperate or fail to operate. In this paper, a power differential protection scheme is proposed, which consists of a main criterion and an auxiliary criterion. The main criterion is constructed based on the energy conservation law. Differential power of line terminals is used to discriminate internal faults from other conditions. Furthermore, an auxiliary criterion is constructed to deal with the false action problem caused by voltage drop of the bus. Although two-point information of the distribution line is used, the scheme has low synchronization requirements. Simulation results by PSCAD/EMTDC verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme under various conditions for distribution network with high penetration of DG.

articleTitle: Efficiency Analysis of a Novel Power Grid Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The traditional fault diagnosis method only uses the protection and circuit breaker alarm messages to determine the fault sections. This paper put forward a new power grid fault track method based on big data platform. It extends the data source to transformer substation and deal with the fault date by the technology of Spark. This method can solve the problem of mass data processing. This paper analyses fault information by data mining and track the malfunction of protection or circuit breaker by decision tree. It can give the reason of fault and optimize the function of fault diagnosis system.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Optimal Dispatch Microgrid Based on AHP and QPSO Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the development of microgrids (MGs) and growing application of renewable energy resources, multi-objective optimal dispatch of MGs deserves more studies. Aiming at a standalone MG which is composed of wind turbines (WTs), photovoltaics (PVs), units of diesel engines (DEs), load and battery energy storage system (BESS), a multi-objective optimal dispatch model is developed. The economic cost, environmental concerns and power supply consistency are expressed by providing sub-objectives with varying priorities. Then, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) algorithm is employed to reasonably specify the weight coefficients of sub-objectives. Quantum particle swarm optimization (QPSO) algorithm is thereafter employed as a solution methodology to conduct the optimization for optimal dispatch of MG. Finally, the validity of the proposed model and solution methodology are confirmed by case studies.

articleTitle: Numerical Performance Comparison of Distributed Photovoltaic Power Station (DPV) Forecasting Model Based on Two Neural Network Approaches
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The power output of distributed photovoltaic power station (DPV) depends on many factors including solar radiation, temperature, wind speed and so on. Because the power output is greatly affected by environmental conditions, it has the characteristics of fluctuation, intermittence, and instability, which brings much challenge for power forecasting [1-2]. In this paper, after studying and analyzing the existing neural network approaches, two photovoltaic power station output prediction methods based on Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) and Long-Short Term Memory(LSTM) are established along with verifying the effectiveness of the algorithm by case studies via the evaluation index.

articleTitle: Non-anticipative Multi-stage Distributionally Robust Unit Commitment Based on the Operational Region of Generators
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To deal with the anticipation problem in existing multistage unit commitment techniques, this paper proposes a novel distributionally robust unit commitment model based on the operational region of generators. Firstly, the single-stage ambiguity set is constructed by the Dirichlet process Gaussian mixture model. Then, a multi-stage unit commitment (UC) model is proposed. In the day-ahead stage, UC and operational region variables are decided in order to eliminate the dynamic constraints of the real-time economic dispatch (ED) problem. At the intraday stage, the real-time ED is decomposed to a series of single-period ED and solved sequentially. The model also considers the operation of energy storage systems. We develop a modified column and constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm to tackle the min-max-max-min structure of the proposed model. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is validated by the case studies based on the IEEE 6-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems.

articleTitle: The Method for Extraction and Identification of Non-intrusive Household Appliances Load Features Based on WPT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To address the problems of non-intrusive household appliances load identification, such as the difficulty of accurately extracting feature parameters and low accuracy of the identification algorithm, a method for extracting and identifying load features of household appliances based on wavelet packet transform is proposed. First, the wavelet packet decomposition algorithm is used to decompose the voltage and current waveforms into eight energy features, and the effective energy features of household appliances are extracted through the difference analysis method. Then, the accurate identification of different household appliances load is achieved by the error reverse propagation neural network method. Experiments show that the proposed method can effectively identify four types of household appliances load, and it proves good reliability and robustness of this method compared to common methods of signal feature extraction for household appliances load.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Regional Multi-energy Complementary Distributed Energy Management and Control Platform Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper builds a distributed energy management and control platform based on big data for distributed energy variety, large capacity, the current situation of distribution and massive amounts of data. The platform uses big data and cloud computing technology to collect grid integration business systems and third-party internet platform of multi-source data, then it carries out data analysis and data mining. It has the functions of comprehensively analyzing the regional distributed energy operation and output, collecting and sending the operation, analyzing the development trend and maintenance information of the abnormal power station. It improves the maintenance efficiency and reduces the impact of the output change on the power grid.

articleTitle: Faulty Line Detection Technique Based on ANN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate and rapid detection of faulty line when single-phase-to-ground fault occurs is crucial to the reliability of power supply. This paper proposes a novel faulty line detection method based on artificial neural network, combining traveling wave and transient current phase information. Firstly, we introduce the existing faulty line detection methods and analyze the effective area of these methods, finding that effective area of the traveling wave method and the transient current phase method is complementary. After obtaining a large number of fault samples with PSCAD/EMTDC, we train and test the artificial neural network. The new faulty line detection method has excellent performance in faulty line detection and has good generalization ability.

articleTitle: Role of Optimal Transmission Switching in Deep Peak Regulation-Enabled Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the shortage of fossil energy and its pollution to the environment, the proportion of renewable energy in the power system is gradually increasing, and the capacity of the power system to accommodate renewable energy needs to be improved urgently. As a large amount of renewable energy is integrated into the power grid, network congestion may occur, making it difficult to accommodate renewable energy. This paper takes optimal transmission switching (OTS) as an important means of accommodating renewable energy, and participates in the operation of the power grid together with the deep peak regulation of thermal power units, forming an interactive mode of coordinated operation of source and network. A stochastic unit commitment model considering deep peak regulation and OTS is established, and the role of OTS for further promoting the accommodation of renewable energy is analyzed quantitatively. Case studies based on the IEEE 30-bus system demonstrate that OTS can further release the potential of deep peak regulation and promote the accommodation of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Power Grid Considering Wind Power Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In traditional power grid planning, only one of the economy and security risk is focused. With that irrationality, the security risk is translated into available transfer capability and added in the objective function. Then, a planning model considering both invest cost and available transfer capability is proposed, to maximize the comprehensive benefits. Finally, an improved niche genetic algorithm, which is used to solve the planning model and then the corresponding optimal scheme is obtained with different wind power penetration. The effectiveness of proposed model and algorithm are verified by case study.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Battery Energy Storage System in the UK Power System for the Frequency Regulation with High Wind Penetration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The integration of large-scale wind farms into national grids can increase the number of sudden frequency deviations. It is desirable to find ways of dealing with these undesirable frequency excursions. This paper describes a study for identifying the optimal regulation of frequency within the UK national grid using battery energy storage systems (BESS) distributed within the electrical power system. The starting point was historical generation, load and wind forecast data. From this a new dynamic model and simulation has been developed that exhibits the correct dynamic behavior observed in the actual data sets. The new dynamic simulation was then used to optimize the use of distributed Battery Energy Storage Systems to provide enhanced frequency regulation in the UK national power grid in the presence of large generation/load imbalances caused by variable renewable generation output. The paper concludes that it is feasible to find a suitable optimal BESS that can operate economically in the national grid to provide frequency regulation and meet low carbon obligations.

articleTitle: Preventive Control optimization of Commutation Failure Based
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the hybrid AC/DC systems, AC system failures may cause the commutation failure of DC system, which will lead to DC blocking and affect the safety and stability of the system. This paper proposes a reactive power optimization method to reduce the risk of system commutation failure. This method aims at minimizing the amount of reactive power control and the number of failure nodes that trigger commutation failure, which takes into account steady-state safety constraints and optimizes generator reactive power output and reactive power compensation capacity. Aiming at this multi-objective optimization problem, an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm with parameter adaptation is proposed. When calculating the particle fitness value, a surrogate model based on the support vector machine (SVM) to evaluate the commutation failure is used to replace the time-domain simulation to improve the particle fitness value calculation speed. An example of a provincial power grid is used to verify the effectiveness and rapidity of the proposed optimization method.

articleTitle: Improvement of Convergence of Power Flow and Convergence Ranking of Load Bus
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The paper mainly discusses the role of conductance model of the heaviest load bus on the convergence of power flow theoretically. Briefly speaking, to analyze the effect of conductance model of load bus on the eigenvalue of symmetrical matrix derived by power flow Jacobian matrix by means of Gerschgorin theorem. The conclusion that conductance model of the heavy load bus is benefit to the convergence of power flow is verified. In addition, a method of convergence ranking of load buses is proposed according to the difference of minimum eigenvalues between power model and conductance(susceptance) model of the same load bus, and to compare the method above with bus sensitivity method on the convergence ranking of load buses.

Author Keywords: Gerschgorin theorem convergence ranking of load buses

articleTitle: Evaluation of Damping of Generator by Using Oscillation Energy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Evaluating damping of generators is beneficial for improving the stability of the power system. The existing damping evaluation methods based on the sixth-order generator model are strongly rely on detailed parameters which are not easy to obtain. To address this problem, a damping evaluation method using oscillation energy and small signal analysis is proposed, the method can evaluate the damping of the sixth-order generator model based on electric parameters. First, the oscillation energy that flow into the sixth-order generator model based on electric parameters is deduced and corresponding equivalent circuits is also given. Second, a damping evaluation index based on oscillation energy is proposed, and then the express of index is given by eigenvector and eigenvalue. Finally, simulation result of a 4-machine system demonstrates the validation of the proposed method for damping evaluation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Subsynchronous Oscillation Caused by Integration of New Wind Farm via MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The integration of new wind farm via modular multilevel converter based high-voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) will lead to subsynchoronous oscillation (SSO). The SSO will activate the protection of MMC-HVDC, and then the whole system will shut down. In order to address this problem, the propagation and distribution of SSO in the whole system are derived. First, the model of wind farms integrated into the power grid through MMC-HVDC is established. Second, the characteristics of SSO caused by the integration of new wind farm is analyzed. The process of propagation of SSO from wind farms to MMC-HVDC is derived. By calculating the instantaneous power of the MMC bridge arms, the frequencies of SSO components present in the system are calculated. The SSO components frequency relationship among wind farm, MMC-HVDC and power grid is revealed. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis is validated by time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: Study on The Influence of Load Characteristics on Switching Strategy of Dynamic Voltage Regulator
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of excessive current in the switching process of the dynamic voltage regulator, and at the same time increase the service life of the thyristor device, ensure that the device can work stably, a phase selection switching control based on load characteristics is proposed Strategy. This paper aims at the problems of transformer saturation and excessive surge current that may occur during the continuous switching process of the traditional dynamic voltage regulator using the switching strategy based on voltage zero crossing. A phase-selective switching control strategy based on load characteristics minimizes the inrush current during switching. After the simulation and analysis based on Matlab/Simulink environment and the actual device test, the zero-crossing switching strategy and the improved control strategy are compared and studied. The method proposed in this paper can reduce the inrush current of the transformer during the switching process. This strategy can improve the reliability, safety, health, and stability of the dynamic voltage regulator, and has important reference value for related dynamic voltage regulator.

articleTitle: Harmonic Contribution Evaluation of Multiple Harmonic Sources Based on Data Selection Method Considering Regression Coefficient Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the access of a large number of distributed energy sources and power electronic equipment, the power quality problems caused by harmonics have attracted widespread attention. Under the premise of grasping power quality monitoring data, it is urgent to determine the source of harmonics, in order to take targeted measures at the source and improve the power quality problems that occur in the system. This paper proposes a method to determine the harmonic contribution of each harmonic source in a multi-harmonic source system based on data selection method considering regression coefficient fluctuation. Firstly, an index factor for evaluating the harmonic contribution based on partial least squares of each harmonic source is established. Then the data selection method based on coefficient fluctuations in the regression model is used to select valid data segments. Finally, by analyzing the harmonic voltage and harmonic current data, the quantitative magnitude of the harmonic responsibility of each harmonic source is determined. The proposed method is convenient in calculation and strong in engineering practice. Simulation analysis and actual case verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Premium Power Value Evaluation Method Based on Prospect Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Power quality disturbance events such as voltage sag have brought huge economic losses to customers. After taking into full consideration the demands of customers, this article sets up premium power value evaluation system based on utility theory in 5 aspects which include reliability value, safety value, economic value, functional and potential value. Then the article analyzes the sensibility when suffering losses from decisionmaking behavior, and the prospect theory is applied to quantify the value of premium power customers used. Finally, a case study of typical customers in a premium power park proves the correctness and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Real-time Prcie Response Analysis for Commercial and Industrial Load Based on Response Cost Minimization
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Analysis of price-response costs was carried out for the industrial and commercial load that can reducible, transferable, and translational. With the goal of minimum load response price cost, the optimal load for each time period is obtained, and the price response function for each type of load under a given real-time price is combined with the optimal load value of the real-time price. Using three different types of typical industrial and commercial loads as an example, the actual response characteristics of each type of load under the real-time price is obtained by modeling the actual production data, and the basis for subsequent model refinement is established.

articleTitle: The Research on SOC Estimation of Lithium Battery Based on GWO-PF
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate estimation of SOC of lithium battery is an important index for the safety and reliability of battery energy storage system. In this paper, a method of estimating SOC Based on GWO-PF is proposed. The particles are represented as gray wolf individuals, imitating the predatory process of gray wolf population, the particle approximates the posterior probability distribution and solves the problem of particle dilution in the traditional particle filter technology. Then, the state space model of the battery is constructed based on the second-order Thevenin battery equivalent model. The SOC simulation experiment of GWO-PF algorithm and standard PF algorithm is carried out under the condition of pulse discharge. Experimental results show that, compared with the traditional PF algorithm, GWO-PF based SOC estimation of lithium battery is more accurate, and has good adaptability and robustness to the process of nonlinear and non Gaussian SOC estimation of lithium battery.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wind Profile for Wind Power Station Development
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This research is making an approach to identify the wind speed and wind direction measurement analysis, which is one of the key features in designing a wind station. The wind data will give a complete idea about the wind potential of the site, which is the fuel for turbines to generate its maximum power under maximum efficiency. This will discuss about how to use the collected wind data to filter and edit in WAsP climate analysis tool in order to maximize the purity of the analysis and finally will model a wind profile by using actual wind measurements collected for 4 years and which can be used to model a wind power station. Finally, it will create the Observed wind climate (OWC). The wind rose and Weibull will be distributed and fitted in the simulations accordingly. Therefore, these data can be a green indication to proceed for a wind turbine site development.

articleTitle: A Novel HVDC Electromagnetic Transient Model for Transient Simulation of DC Feed-in Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel electromagnetic transient model of high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system, which is mainly applied in the DC feed-in system to simulate the commutation failure of DC system caused by the AC fault on the inverter side. In this model, the quasisteady-state model is used to simulate the electrical characteristics of converter transformer and converter on the rectifier side. All the primary equipments of DC line and DC system on inverter side are reserved, which adopt electromagnetic transient model. In addition, the DC control system applies detailed model without any simplification. In this way, the computing speed can be improved without affecting the simulation accuracy of the dynamic response on the inverter side. By setting up an testing example in the electromagnetic transient simulation software, the simulation results indicate that the proposed model can accurately simulate the commutation failure caused by the AC fault on the inverter side, and its calculation amount is only about 1/3 of the calculation amount of two-terminal electromagnetic transient model.

articleTitle: Hybrid Measurement Fusion Estimation of Distribution Network Based on Quadratic Constrained Quadratic Estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In view of the long-term coexistence of PMU measurement and SCADA measurement in the current power system, this paper analyzes the measurement characteristics of the distribution network. On the basis of the quadratic constraint quadratic estimation model, the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) algorithm is introduced to realize the fusion estimation of mixed measurement. The main research contents of this paper are as follows: First, the quadratic constraint estimation model is established, and the hybrid measurement quadratic constraint equation and hybrid measurement equation of PMU and SCADA are proposed; Second, in order to solve the problem of weak robustness of UKF, a Robust Unscented Kalman Filter based on Quadratic Constrained Quadratic Estimation (QCQE-RUKF) is proposed. The Strong Tracking Filter(STF) is introduced to modify the gain matrix in real time to enhance the robustness of the algorithm. Simulation results carried out on the IEEE 30-bus test system show that the QCQE-RUKF can track system status more accurately and reliably than UKF and Extended Kalman Filter (EKF).

articleTitle: Investigation on Oil-paper Insulation Air-gap Discharge Process Based on Multi-scale Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Air-gap discharge is the main type of partial discharge within the power transformer. It is of great significance to study the discharge development stage for the monitoring and diagnosis of transformer potential faults.
